=== portal.ex ===
defmodule CleanerCrm.Portal do
  @moduledoc """
  Client-facing portal domain: magic-link session tokens for clients
  (no password accounts), the client's view of upcoming visits with
  assigned-cleaner identity, service history with proof-of-work, and
  self-service reschedule/cancel enforcement against the account's
  cancellation policy.

  Every function here takes a `CleanerCrm.Clients.Client` directly
  rather than a `CleanerCrm.Users.Scope` — a portal visitor is a
  client reached through a magic link, never a logged-in staff user.
  Internally, calls into `Scheduling`, `Quality`, `Billing`, and
  `Notifications` are scoped by deriving a `Scope` from the client's
  own `account_id`.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false

  alias CleanerCrm.Billing
  alias CleanerCrm.Billing.Invoice
  alias CleanerCrm.Clients
  alias CleanerCrm.Clients.Client
  alias CleanerCrm.Notifications
  alias CleanerCrm.Portal.{CancellationPolicy, PortalSession, Tip}
  alias CleanerCrm.Quality
  alias CleanerCrm.Repo
  alias CleanerCrm.Scheduling
  alias CleanerCrm.Scheduling.Job
  alias CleanerCrm.Users.Scope

  ## Magic-link sessions

  @doc """
  Issues a fresh portal session for `client`, returning the record
  with its plaintext `:token` set — the only time that token is ever
  available, so the caller (booking confirmation, "email me a link")
  must send or redirect with it immediately.
  """
  def create_portal_session(%Client{} = client, attrs \\ %{}) do
    client
    |> PortalSession.build_changeset(attrs)
    |> Repo.insert()
  end

  @doc """
  Exchanges a magic-link token for the client id it grants access to.
  Touches the session's `last_used_at` on success. Fails closed with
  `{:error, :invalid}` for a token that doesn't match any session, or
  one that's expired — a client offered the same "your link is
  invalid or expired" outcome either way, never told which.
  """
  def access_portal(token) when is_binary(token) do
    case Repo.get_by(PortalSession, token_hash: PortalSession.hash_token(token)) do
      nil -> {:error, :invalid}
      %PortalSession{} = session -> exchange(session)
    end
  end

  defp exchange(%PortalSession{} = session) do
    if PortalSession.expired?(session) do
      {:error, :invalid}
    else
      {:ok, _touched} = session |> PortalSession.touch_changeset() |> Repo.update()
      {:ok, session.client_id}
    end
  end

  @doc "Loads a client by id — the portal session carries only the id, never the whole struct."
  def get_client!(client_id), do: Repo.get!(Client, client_id)

  ## Visits

  @doc """
  The client's upcoming (today or later, not cancelled) visits,
  soonest first, cleaner preloaded for name/photo display.
  """
  def list_upcoming_visits(%Client{} = client) do
    client
    |> account_scope()
    |> Scheduling.list_jobs()
    |> Enum.filter(&(&1.client_id == client.id and &1.status in [:scheduled, :in_progress]))
    |> Enum.filter(&(Date.compare(&1.scheduled_date, Date.utc_today()) != :lt))
    |> Enum.sort_by(&{&1.scheduled_date, &1.start_time})
  end

  @doc """
  The client's completed visits, most recent first — each one's
  checklist and before/after photos are read separately via
  `visit_checklist/1`.
  """
  def list_visit_history(%Client{} = client) do
    client
    |> account_scope()
    |> Scheduling.list_jobs()
    |> Enum.filter(&(&1.client_id == client.id and &1.status == :completed))
    |> Enum.sort_by(& &1.scheduled_date, {:desc, Date})
  end

  @doc "A completed visit's checklist with items and photos preloaded, or `nil` if it has none."
  def visit_checklist(%Job{} = job) do
    Quality.get_checklist_for_job(system_scope(job.account_id), job)
  end

  @doc """
  Fetches a single visit for the portal's visit-detail page. Raises
  if `job_id` doesn't belong to `client` — the account-scoped lookup
  alone isn't enough, since other clients on the same account must
  never reach each other's visits by guessing an id.
  """
  def get_visit!(%Client{} = client, job_id) do
    job = Scheduling.get_job!(account_scope(client), job_id)

    case job.client_id do
      client_id when client_id == client.id -> job
      _other -> raise Ecto.NoResultsError, queryable: Job
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Reschedules a visit to a new date/start time, preserving its
  original duration, agreed price, and assigned cleaner. Notifies the
  assigned cleaner (and, through their unacknowledged status, the
  office) the same way a staff-driven reschedule does. Refused with
  `{:error, :not_modifiable}` for a completed or already-cancelled
  visit.
  """
  def reschedule_visit(%Client{} = client, %Job{} = job, %{
        "date" => date_input,
        "start_time" => start_time_input
      }) do
    scope = account_scope(client)

    with :ok <- ensure_modifiable(job),
         {:ok, date} <- parse_date(date_input),
         {:ok, start_time} <- parse_time(start_time_input),
         {:ok, updated} <-
           Scheduling.update_job(scope, job, %{
             scheduled_date: date,
             start_time: start_time,
             end_time: shift_end_time(job, start_time)
           }) do
      notify_schedule_change(
        scope,
        updated,
        "Visit rescheduled by the client from #{schedule_label(job)} to #{schedule_label(updated)}"
      )

      {:ok, updated}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  The fee a client would be charged for cancelling `job` right now:
  the account's same-day fee if the visit is scheduled for today, its
  late fee if cancelling inside the notice window, otherwise zero.
  """
  def cancellation_fee_cents(%Client{} = client, %Job{} = job) do
    policy = get_cancellation_policy(client.account_id)
    fee_for(policy, job)
  end

  defp fee_for(%CancellationPolicy{} = policy, %Job{} = job) do
    cond do
      Date.compare(job.scheduled_date, Date.utc_today()) == :eq -> policy.same_day_fee_cents
      hours_until_visit(job) < policy.notice_window_hours -> policy.late_fee_cents
      true -> 0
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Cancels a visit, refusing with `{:error, :not_modifiable}` for one
  already completed or cancelled. Returns the fee charged alongside
  the updated visit — computed against the moment cancellation was
  requested, not looked up again afterward — and notifies the
  assigned cleaner of the cancellation.
  """
  def cancel_visit(%Client{} = client, %Job{} = job) do
    with :ok <- ensure_modifiable(job) do
      scope = account_scope(client)
      fee_cents = cancellation_fee_cents(client, job)

      with {:ok, updated} <- Scheduling.cancel_job(scope, job) do
        notify_schedule_change(scope, updated, "Visit cancelled by the client")
        {:ok, updated, fee_cents}
      end
    end
  end

  ## Cancellation policy

  @doc "The account's cancellation policy, defaulting to a fresh, unsaved (all-zero-fee) one."
  def get_cancellation_policy(account_id) when not is_nil(account_id) do
    case Repo.get_by(CancellationPolicy, account_id: account_id) do
      nil -> %CancellationPolicy{account_id: account_id}
      policy -> policy
    end
  end

  @doc "Sets (creating or updating) the account's cancellation policy."
  def set_cancellation_policy(%Scope{active_account_id: account_id}, attrs)
      when not is_nil(account_id) do
    account_id
    |> get_cancellation_policy()
    |> CancellationPolicy.changeset(attrs)
    |> Repo.insert_or_update()
  end

  ## Invoices and payment

  @doc "Every invoice for `client`'s own jobs, most recent first."
  def list_invoices(%Client{} = client) do
    Invoice
    |> join(:inner, [i], j in Job, on: j.id == i.job_id)
    |> where([i, j], j.client_id == ^client.id)
    |> order_by([i], desc: i.inserted_at)
    |> preload(job: :client)
    |> Repo.all()
  end

  @doc """
  Pays an invoice from the portal: submits the charge (per the
  payments-stripe ADR, this only moves the invoice to
  `:charge_pending` — final `:paid` status is webhook-driven), then
  optionally saves the card on file and records a tip against the
  visit's assigned cleaner.

  `attrs` (string-keyed, straight off the payment form): `"card_token"`
  (required), `"save_card"` (`"true"`/`"on"` to save), `"tip_cents"`
  (blank or omitted to skip the tip).
  """
  def pay_invoice(%Client{} = client, %Invoice{} = invoice, attrs) do
    with {:ok, updated_invoice} <- Billing.pay_via_link(invoice, Map.get(attrs, "card_token")) do
      maybe_save_card(client, attrs)
      maybe_record_tip(updated_invoice, attrs)
      {:ok, updated_invoice}
    end
  end

  defp maybe_save_card(%Client{} = client, %{"save_card" => save_card})
       when save_card in ["true", "on"] do
    Clients.update_client(system_scope(client.account_id), client, %{card_on_file: true})
  end

  defp maybe_save_card(_client, _attrs), do: :ok

  defp maybe_record_tip(%Invoice{} = invoice, attrs) do
    case parse_tip_cents(Map.get(attrs, "tip_cents")) do
      cents when is_integer(cents) and cents > 0 -> record_tip(invoice, cents)
      _no_tip -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp record_tip(%Invoice{} = invoice, cents) do
    %Tip{
      account_id: invoice.account_id,
      invoice_id: invoice.id,
      cleaner_id: invoice.job.cleaner_id
    }
    |> Tip.changeset(%{
      amount_cents: cents,
      stripe_payment_intent_id: invoice.stripe_payment_intent_id
    })
    |> Repo.insert()
  end

  @doc """
  Cents a cleaner has been tipped through the portal within `period`
  (a `{start_date, end_date}` tuple, matching
  `CleanerCrm.TimeTracking.current_pay_period/1`'s own shape) — read
  by `CleanerCrmWeb.FieldLive.EarningsComponent` to fold tips into a
  cleaner's pay-period total alongside their time-tracked earnings.
  """
  def tip_cents_for_cleaner(
        %Scope{active_account_id: account_id},
        cleaner_id,
        {start_date, end_date}
      )
      when not is_nil(account_id) do
    start_at = DateTime.new!(start_date, ~T[00:00:00])
    end_at = DateTime.new!(Date.add(end_date, 1), ~T[00:00:00])

    Tip
    |> where(
      [t],
      t.account_id == ^account_id and t.cleaner_id == ^cleaner_id and
        t.inserted_at >= ^start_at and t.inserted_at < ^end_at
    )
    |> select([t], sum(t.amount_cents))
    |> Repo.one()
    |> Kernel.||(0)
  end

  ## Shared helpers

  defp account_scope(%Client{account_id: account_id}), do: system_scope(account_id)

  defp system_scope(account_id), do: %Scope{active_account_id: account_id}

  defp ensure_modifiable(%Job{status: status}) when status in [:completed, :cancelled],
    do: {:error, :not_modifiable}

  defp ensure_modifiable(%Job{}), do: :ok

  defp parse_date(%Date{} = date), do: {:ok, date}
  defp parse_date(string) when is_binary(string), do: Date.from_iso8601(string)

  defp parse_time(%Time{} = time), do: {:ok, time}

  defp parse_time(string) when is_binary(string) do
    case String.split(string, ":") do
      [_hour, _minute] -> Time.from_iso8601(string <> ":00")
      _other -> Time.from_iso8601(string)
    end
  end

  defp parse_tip_cents(value) when value in [nil, ""], do: nil

  defp parse_tip_cents(value) when is_binary(value) do
    case Integer.parse(value) do
      {cents, _rest} -> cents
      :error -> nil
    end
  end

  # Moves `start_time` in by the same amount the visit already runs,
  # clamping to end-of-day rather than wrapping past midnight into an
  # earlier clock time — mirrors
  # `CleanerCrmSpex.Fixtures`' own `default_end_time/1` safeguard.
  defp shift_end_time(%Job{} = job, %Time{} = start_time) do
    {start_seconds, _} = Time.to_seconds_after_midnight(job.start_time)
    {end_seconds, _} = Time.to_seconds_after_midnight(job.end_time)
    candidate = Time.add(start_time, end_seconds - start_seconds, :second)

    if Time.compare(candidate, start_time) == :gt, do: candidate, else: ~T[23:59:59]
  end

  defp hours_until_visit(%Job{scheduled_date: date, start_time: time}) do
    visit_at = DateTime.new!(date, time, "Etc/UTC")
    DateTime.diff(visit_at, DateTime.utc_now(), :hour)
  end

  defp notify_schedule_change(_scope, %Job{cleaner_id: nil}, _summary), do: :ok

  defp notify_schedule_change(scope, %Job{} = job, summary) do
    Notifications.create_notification(scope, %{
      cleaner_id: job.cleaner_id,
      job_id: job.id,
      kind: :schedule_change,
      channel: :push,
      status: :pending,
      change_summary: summary,
      pushed_at: DateTime.utc_now(),
      token: "portal_schedule_change_#{job.id}_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}"
    })
  end

  defp schedule_label(%Job{} = job),
    do:
      "#{job.scheduled_date} #{format_time_12h(job.start_time)}-#{format_time_12h(job.end_time)}"

  defp format_time_12h(%Time{} = time) do
    {hour, period} = to_12_hour(time.hour)
    minute = time.minute |> Integer.to_string() |> String.pad_leading(2, "0")
    "#{hour}:#{minute} #{period}"
  end

  defp to_12_hour(0), do: {12, "AM"}
  defp to_12_hour(hour) when hour < 12, do: {hour, "AM"}
  defp to_12_hour(12), do: {12, "PM"}
  defp to_12_hour(hour), do: {hour - 12, "PM"}
end

  end

  @doc """
  Exchanges a magic-link token for the client id it grants access to.
  Touches the session's `last_used_at` on success. Fails closed with
  `{:error, :invalid}` for a token that doesn't match any session, or
  one that's expired — a client offered the same "your link is
  invalid or expired" outcome either way, never told which.
  """
  def access_portal(token) when is_binary(token) do
    case Repo.get_by(PortalSession, token_hash: PortalSession.hash_token(token)) do
      nil -> {:error, :invalid}
      %PortalSession{} = session -> exchange(session)
    end
  end

  defp exchange(%PortalSession{} = session) do
    if PortalSession.expired?(session) do
      {:error, :invalid}
    else
      {:ok, _touched} = session |> PortalSession.touch_changeset() |> Repo.update()
      {:ok, session.client_id}
    end
  end

  @doc "Loads a client by id — the portal session carries only the id, never the whole struct."
  def get_client!(client_id), do: Repo.get!(Client, client_id)

  ## Visits

  @doc """
  The client's upcoming (today or later, not cancelled) visits,
  soonest first, cleaner preloaded for name/photo display.
  """
  def list_upcoming_visits(%Client{} = client) do
    client
    |> account_scope()
    |> Scheduling.list_jobs()
    |> Enum.filter(&(&1.client_id == client.id and &1.status in [:scheduled, :in_progress]))
    |> Enum.filter(&(Date.compare(&1.scheduled_date, Date.utc_today()) != :lt))
    |> Enum.sort_by(&{&1.scheduled_date, &1.start_time})
  end

  @doc """
  The client's completed visits, most recent first — each one's
  checklist and before/after photos are read separately via
  `visit_checklist/1`.
  """
  def list_visit_history(%Client{} = client) do
    client
    |> account_scope()
    |> Scheduling.list_jobs()
    |> Enum.filter(&(&1.client_id == client.id and &1.status == :completed))
    |> Enum.sort_by(& &1.scheduled_date, {:desc, Date})
  end

  @doc "A completed visit's checklist with items and photos preloaded, or `nil` if it has none."
  def visit_checklist(%Job{} = job) do
    Quality.get_checklist_for_job(system_scope(job.account_id), job)
  end

  @doc """
  Fetches a single visit for the portal's visit-detail page. Raises
  if `job_id` doesn't belong to `client` — the account-scoped lookup
  alone isn't enough, since other clients on the same account must
  never reach each other's visits by guessing an id.
  """
  def get_visit!(%Client{} = client, job_id) do
    job = Scheduling.get_job!(account_scope(client), job_id)

    case job.client_id do
      client_id when client_id == client.id -> job
      _other -> raise Ecto.NoResultsError, queryable: Job
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Reschedules a visit to a new date/start time, preserving its
  original duration, agreed price, and assigned cleaner. Notifies the
  assigned cleaner (and, through their unacknowledged status, the
  office) the same way a staff-driven reschedule does. Refused with
  `{:error, :not_modifiable}` for a completed or already-cancelled
  visit.
  """
  def reschedule_visit(%Client{} = client, %Job{} = job, %{
        "date" => date_input,
        "start_time" => start_time_input
      }) do
    scope = account_scope(client)

    with :ok <- ensure_modifiable(job),
         {:ok, date} <- parse_date(date_input),
         {:ok, start_time} <- parse_time(start_time_input),
         {:ok, updated} <-
           Scheduling.update_job(scope, job, %{
             scheduled_date: date,
             start_time: start_time,
             end_time: shift_end_time(job, start_time)
           }) do
      notify_schedule_change(
        scope,
        updated,
        "Visit rescheduled by the client from #{schedule_label(job)} to #{schedule_label(updated)}"
      )

      {:ok, updated}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  The fee a client would be charged for cancelling `job` right now:
  the account's same-day fee if the visit is scheduled for today, its
  late fee if cancelling inside the notice window, otherwise zero.
  """
  def cancellation_fee_cents(%Client{} = client, %Job{} = job) do
    policy = get_cancellation_policy(client.account_id)
    fee_for(policy, job)
  end

  defp fee_for(%CancellationPolicy{} = policy, %Job{} = job) do
    cond do
      Date.compare(job.scheduled_date, Date.utc_today()) == :eq -> policy.same_day_fee_cents
      hours_until_visit(job) < policy.notice_window_hours -> policy.late_fee_cents
      true -> 0
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Cancels a visit, refusing with `{:error, :not_modifiable}` for one
  already completed or cancelled. Returns the fee charged alongside
  the updated visit — computed against the moment cancellation was
  requested, not looked up again afterward — and notifies the
  assigned cleaner of the cancellation.
  """
  def cancel_visit(%Client{} = client, %Job{} = job) do
    with :ok <- ensure_modifiable(job) do
      scope = account_scope(client)
      fee_cents = cancellation_fee_cents(client, job)

      with {:ok, updated} <- Scheduling.cancel_job(scope, job) do
        notify_schedule_change(scope, updated, "Visit cancelled by the client")
        {:ok, updated, fee_cents}
      end
    end
  end

  ## Cancellation policy

  @doc "The account's cancellation policy, defaulting to a fresh, unsaved (all-zero-fee) one."
  def get_cancellation_policy(account_id) when not is_nil(account_id) do
    case Repo.get_by(CancellationPolicy, account_id: account_id) do
      nil -> %CancellationPolicy{account_id: account_id}
      policy -> policy
    end
  end

  @doc "Sets (creating or updating) the account's cancellation policy."
  def set_cancellation_policy(%Scope{active_account_id: account_id}, attrs)
      when not is_nil(account_id) do
    account_id
    |> get_cancellation_policy()
    |> CancellationPolicy.changeset(attrs)
    |> Repo.insert_or_update()
  end

  ## Invoices and payment

  @doc "Every invoice for `client`'s own jobs, most recent first."
  def list_invoices(%Client{} = client) do
    Invoice
    |> join(:inner, [i], j in Job, on: j.id == i.job_id)
    |> where([i, j], j.client_id == ^client.id)
    |> order_by([i], desc: i.inserted_at)
    |> preload(job: :client)
    |> Repo.all()
  end

  @doc """
  Pays an invoice from the portal: submits the charge (per the
  payments-stripe ADR, this only moves the invoice to
  `:charge_pending` — final `:paid` status is webhook-driven), then
  optionally saves the card on file and records a tip against the
  visit's assigned cleaner.

  `attrs` (string-keyed, straight off the payment form): `"card_token"`
  (required), `"save_card"` (`"true"`/`"on"` to save), `"tip_cents"`
  (blank or omitted to skip the tip).
  """
  def pay_invoice(%Client{} = client, %Invoice{} = invoice, attrs) do
    with {:ok, updated_invoice} <- Billing.pay_via_link(invoice, Map.get(attrs, "card_token")) do
      maybe_save_card(client, attrs)
      maybe_record_tip(updated_invoice, attrs)
      {:ok, updated_invoice}
    end
  end

  defp maybe_save_card(%Client{} = client, %{"save_card" => save_card})
       when save_card in ["true", "on"] do
    Clients.update_client(system_scope(client.account_id), client, %{card_on_file: true})
  end

  defp maybe_save_card(_client, _attrs), do: :ok

  defp maybe_record_tip(%Invoice{} = invoice, attrs) do
    case parse_tip_cents(Map.get(attrs, "tip_cents")) do
      cents when is_integer(cents) and cents > 0 -> record_tip(invoice, cents)
      _no_tip -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp record_tip(%Invoice{} = invoice, cents) do
    %Tip{
      account_id: invoice.account_id,
      invoice_id: invoice.id,
      cleaner_id: invoice.job.cleaner_id
    }
    |> Tip.changeset(%{
      amount_cents: cents,
      stripe_payment_intent_id: invoice.stripe_payment_intent_id
    })
    |> Repo.insert()
  end

  @doc """
  Cents a cleaner has been tipped through the portal within `period`
  (a `{start_date, end_date}` tuple, matching
  `CleanerCrm.TimeTracking.current_pay_period/1`'s own shape) — read
  by `CleanerCrmWeb.FieldLive.EarningsComponent` to fold tips into a
  cleaner's pay-period total alongside their time-tracked earnings.
  """
  def tip_cents_for_cleaner(
        %Scope{active_account_id: account_id},
        cleaner_id,
        {start_date, end_date}
      )
      when not is_nil(account_id) do
    start_at = DateTime.new!(start_date, ~T[00:00:00])
    end_at = DateTime.new!(Date.add(end_date, 1), ~T[00:00:00])

    Tip
    |> where(
      [t],
      t.account_id == ^account_id and t.cleaner_id == ^cleaner_id and
        t.inserted_at >= ^start_at and t.inserted_at < ^end_at
    )
    |> select([t], sum(t.amount_cents))
    |> Repo.one()
    |> Kernel.||(0)
  end

  ## Shared helpers

  defp account_scope(%Client{account_id: account_id}), do: system_scope(account_id)

  defp system_scope(account_id), do: %Scope{active_account_id: account_id}

  defp ensure_modifiable(%Job{status: status}) when status in [:completed, :cancelled],
    do: {:error, :not_modifiable}

  defp ensure_modifiable(%Job{}), do: :ok

  defp parse_date(%Date{} = date), do: {:ok, date}
  defp parse_date(string) when is_binary(string), do: Date.from_iso8601(string)

  defp parse_time(%Time{} = time), do: {:ok, time}

  defp parse_time(string) when is_binary(string) do
    case String.split(string, ":") do
      [_hour, _minute] -> Time.from_iso8601(string <> ":00")
      _other -> Time.from_iso8601(string)
    end
  end

  defp parse_tip_cents(value) when value in [nil, ""], do: nil

  defp parse_tip_cents(value) when is_binary(value) do
    case Integer.parse(value) do
      {cents, _rest} -> cents
      :error -> nil
    end
  end

  # Moves `start_time` in by the same amount the visit already runs,
  # clamping to end-of-day rather than wrapping past midnight into an
  # earlier clock time — mirrors
  # `CleanerCrmSpex.Fixtures`' own `default_end_time/1` safeguard.
  defp shift_end_time(%Job{} = job, %Time{} = start_time) do
    {start_seconds, _} = Time.to_seconds_after_midnight(job.start_time)
    {end_seconds, _} = Time.to_seconds_after_midnight(job.end_time)
    candidate = Time.add(start_time, end_seconds - start_seconds, :second)

    if Time.compare(candidate, start_time) == :gt, do: candidate, else: ~T[23:59:59]
  end

  defp hours_until_visit(%Job{scheduled_date: date, start_time: time}) do
    visit_at = DateTime.new!(date, time, "Etc/UTC")
    DateTime.diff(visit_at, DateTime.utc_now(), :hour)
  end

  defp notify_schedule_change(_scope, %Job{cleaner_id: nil}, _summary), do: :ok

  defp notify_schedule_change(scope, %Job{} = job, summary) do
    Notifications.create_notification(scope, %{
      cleaner_id: job.cleaner_id,
      job_id: job.id,
      kind: :schedule_change,
      channel: :push,
      status: :pending,
      change_summary: summary,
      pushed_at: DateTime.utc_now(),
      token: "portal_schedule_change_#{job.id}_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}"
    })
  end

  defp schedule_label(%Job{} = job),
    do:
      "#{job.scheduled_date} #{format_time_12h(job.start_time)}-#{format_time_12h(job.end_time)}"

  defp format_time_12h(%Time{} = time) do
    {hour, period} = to_12_hour(time.hour)
    minute = time.minute |> Integer.to_string() |> String.pad_leading(2, "0")
    "#{hour}:#{minute} #{period}"
  end

  defp to_12_hour(0), do: {12, "AM"}
  defp to_12_hour(hour) when hour < 12, do: {hour, "AM"}
  defp to_12_hour(12), do: {12, "PM"}
  defp to_12_hour(hour), do: {hour - 12, "PM"}
end

defmodule CleanerCrm.Portal.CancellationPolicy do
  @moduledoc """
  Per-account reschedule/cancel policy: how much notice a client must
  give before a visit to cancel free of charge, the flat fee charged
  inside that window, the (typically higher) flat fee for a same-day
  cancellation, and the policy text shown to a client at booking.
  """

  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
          id: Ecto.UUID.t() | nil,
          account_id: Ecto.UUID.t() | nil,
          notice_window_hours: integer(),
          late_fee_cents: integer(),
          same_day_fee_cents: integer(),
          policy_text: String.t() | nil,
          inserted_at: DateTime.t() | nil,
          updated_at: DateTime.t() | nil
        }

  @primary_key {:id, :binary_id, autogenerate: true}
  schema "cancellation_policies" do
    field :notice_window_hours, :integer, default: 24
    field :late_fee_cents, :integer, default: 0
    field :same_day_fee_cents, :integer, default: 0
    field :policy_text, :string

    belongs_to :account, CleanerCrm.Accounts.Account, type: :binary_id

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime_usec)
  end

  @fields ~w(notice_window_hours late_fee_cents same_day_fee_cents policy_text)a

  @doc """
  The slot-selection step's own changeset — the chosen date and start
  time, required and rejected outright if already in the past (issue
  4e985412: this form accepted any date, including years-old ones,
  with zero validation). `now` defaults to the real clock but takes an
  override so callers can test the boundary without sleeping.
  """
  def slot_changeset(lead, attrs, now \\ DateTime.utc_now()) do
    lead
    |> cast(attrs, [:scheduled_date, :start_time])
    |> validate_required([:scheduled_date, :start_time], message: "is required")
    |> validate_slot_in_future(now)
  end

  @doc "The confirmation step's own changeset — the policy-agreement checkbox."
  def confirmation_changeset(lead, attrs) do
    cast(lead, attrs, [:policy_agreed])
  end

  @doc """
  Whether a lead's `scheduled_date`/`start_time` are still ahead of
  `now` (defaulting to the real clock) — today counts only if
  `start_time` hasn't passed yet. `false` for either field unset.

  The single source of truth behind two checks: `slot_changeset/3`'s
  own validation above (the form-level guard), and
  `CleanerCrm.Booking.confirm_booking/3`'s defense-in-depth re-check
  right before a card is charged — a slot picked as "later today" can
  go stale by the time the client actually submits payment, the same
  reason `CleanerCrm.Scheduling.slot_available?/4` gets re-checked
  there too.
  """
  @spec slot_in_future?(t(), DateTime.t()) :: boolean()
  def slot_in_future?(lead, now \\ DateTime.utc_now())

  def slot_in_future?(%__MODULE__{scheduled_date: nil}, _now), do: false
  def slot_in_future?(%__MODULE__{start_time: nil}, _now), do: false

  def slot_in_future?(%__MODULE__{scheduled_date: date, start_time: start_time}, now) do
    case Date.compare(date, DateTime.to_date(now)) do
      :gt -> true
      :lt -> false
      :eq -> Time.compare(start_time, DateTime.to_time(now)) == :gt
    end
  end

  defp validate_slot_in_future(changeset, now) do
    date = get_field(changeset, :scheduled_date)
    start_time = get_field(changeset, :start_time)

    cond do
      is_nil(date) or is_nil(start_time) ->
        changeset

      slot_in_future?(%__MODULE__{scheduled_date: date, start_time: start_time}, now) ->
        changeset

      Date.compare(date, DateTime.to_date(now)) == :lt ->
        add_error(changeset, :scheduled_date, "must be today or later")

      true ->
        add_error(changeset, :start_time, "must be later than the current time")
    end
  end

  def handle_event("confirm_booking", %{"booking" => params}, socket) do
    case Booking.confirm_booking(socket.assigns.lead, params) do
      {:ok, updated} ->
        {:noreply,
         socket
         |> assign(:lead, updated)
         |> assign(:step, :payment_pending)
         |> assign(:policy_required, false)
         |> assign(:slot_unavailable, false)}

      {:error, :policy_required} ->
        {:noreply, socket |> assign(:policy_required, true) |> assign(:slot_unavailable, false)}

      {:error, :slot_unavailable} ->
        {:noreply, socket |> assign(:slot_unavailable, true) |> assign(:policy_required, false)}

      # Defense in depth (issue 4e985412): the slot-selection form
      # itself now rejects a past date/time, but a slot picked as
      # "later today" can still go stale by the time the client
      # reaches this step — send them back to pick a new one rather
      # than leave them stuck retrying a confirmation that can never
      # succeed.
      {:error, :slot_in_past} ->
        {:noreply,
         socket
         |> assign(:step, :select_slot)
         |> assign(:slot_form, to_form(Booking.change_slot(socket.assigns.lead), as: :booking))
         |> assign(:policy_required, false)
         |> assign(:slot_unavailable, false)
         |> Phoenix.LiveView.put_flash(
           :error,
           "That time has already passed — please pick another slot."
         )}

      {:error, _reason} ->
        {:noreply, socket |> assign(:slot_unavailable, true) |> assign(:policy_required, false)}

defmodule CleanerCrmWeb.BookingLive.Accept do @moduledoc """ Token-link quote acceptance (story 849): the locked price recap, slot selection, cancellation-policy agreement, and card capture that converts a `CleanerCrm.Booking.Lead` into a client + property + plan/job and issues portal access. Mounted as the `:accept` `live_action` of `CleanerCrmWeb.BookingLive.Quote` rather than routed on its own — see that module's moduledoc for why (`push_patch/2` only navigates within the currently-mounted view module, and the calculator patches here once contact info locks in a price). Every function below still only ever touches `CleanerCrm.Booking`. ## Dependencies - `CleanerCrm.Booking` """ use CleanerCrmWeb, :html alias CleanerCrm.Booking alias CleanerCrm.Booking.Lead alias CleanerCrm.Money @doc "Loads the lead for `token` and sets up whichever step it's currently at." def mount(token, socket) do case Booking.get_lead_by_token(token) do nil -> socket |> assign(:page_title, "Booking not found") |> assign(:step, :not_found) |> assign(:lead, nil) %Lead{} = lead -> socket |> assign(:page_title, "Confirm your booking") |> assign(:lead, lead) |> assign(:slot_form, to_form(Booking.change_slot(lead), as: :booking)) |> assign(:confirmation_form, to_form(Booking.change_confirmation(lead), as: :booking)) |> assign(:slot_unavailable, false) |> assign(:policy_required, false) |> assign(:step, step_for(lead)) end end defp step_for(%Lead{status: :converted}), do: :confirmed defp step_for(%Lead{status: :payment_pending}), do: :payment_pending defp step_for(%Lead{status: :payment_declined}), do: :payment_declined defp step_for(%Lead{scheduled_date: nil}), do: :select_slot defp step_for(%Lead{}), do: :confirm def render(assigns) do ~H""" <.header>Confirm your booking

We couldn't find that booking link. It may have expired — please request a new quote.

Your price

{Money.format_cents(@lead.total_cents)}

Locked in from your instant quote — no added fees.

You're booked for {format_date(@lead.scheduled_date)} at {format_time(@lead.start_time)}. Check your email for a link to your client portal.
Confirming your payment — this page will update as soon as it's done.
Your card was declined. Please try a different card below.
That time was just booked by someone else — please pick another slot.
<.form :if={@step == :select_slot} for={@slot_form} id="slot-form" data-test="slot-form" phx-submit="select_slot" > <.input field={@slot_form[:scheduled_date]} type="date" label="Date" /> <.input field={@slot_form[:start_time]} type="time" label="Start time" />
<.button phx-disable-with="Checking...">Continue
<.form :if={@step in [:confirm, :payment_declined]} for={@confirmation_form} id="confirmation-form" data-test="confirmation-form" phx-submit="confirm_booking" >

Cancellation policy: cancel or reschedule at least 24-hour ahead of your visit to avoid a late-cancellation fee.

<.input field={@confirmation_form[:policy_agreed]} type="checkbox" label="I agree to the cancellation policy" data-test="policy-agreement-checkbox" />

Please agree to the cancellation policy to continue.

<%!-- Real card capture (Stripe Elements) is deferred — this mirrors the existing `/pay/:token` payment page's own simplification, a single test card baked in as a hidden field until Elements lands. --%>
<.button phx-disable-with="Booking..."> Confirm & pay {Money.format_cents(@lead.total_cents)}
""" end def handle_event("select_slot", %{"booking" => params}, socket) do case Booking.select_slot(socket.assigns.lead, params) do {:ok, slotted_lead} -> {:noreply, socket |> assign(:lead, slotted_lead) |> assign(:step, :confirm)} {:error, changeset} -> {:noreply, assign(socket, :slot_form, to_form(changeset, as: :booking))}

Every function below still only ever touches `CleanerCrm.Booking`. ## Dependencies - `CleanerCrm.Booking` """ use CleanerCrmWeb, :html alias CleanerCrm.Booking alias CleanerCrm.Booking.Lead alias CleanerCrm.Money @doc "Loads the lead for `token` and sets up whichever step it's currently at." def mount(token, socket) do case Booking.get_lead_by_token(token) do nil -> socket |> assign(:page_title, "Booking not found") |> assign(:step, :not_found) |> assign(:lead, nil) %Lead{} = lead -> socket |> assign(:page_title, "Confirm your booking") |> assign(:lead, lead) |> assign(:slot_form, to_form(Booking.change_slot(lead), as: :booking)) |> assign(:confirmation_form, to_form(Booking.change_confirmation(lead), as: :booking)) |> assign(:slot_unavailable, false) |> assign(:policy_required, false) |> assign(:step, step_for(lead)) end end defp step_for(%Lead{status: :converted}), do: :confirmed defp step_for(%Lead{status: :payment_pending}), do: :payment_pending defp step_for(%Lead{status: :payment_declined}), do: :payment_declined defp step_for(%Lead{scheduled_date: nil}), do: :select_slot defp step_for(%Lead{}), do: :confirm def render(assigns) do ~H""" <.header>Confirm your booking

We couldn't find that booking link. It may have expired — please request a new quote.

Your price

{Money.format_cents(@lead.total_cents)}

Locked in from your instant quote — no added fees.

You're booked for {format_date(@lead.scheduled_date)} at {format_time(@lead.start_time)}. Check your email for a link to your client portal.
Confirming your payment — this page will update as soon as it's done.
Your card was declined. Please try a different card below.
That time was just booked by someone else — please pick another slot.
<.form :if={@step == :select_slot} for={@slot_form} id="slot-form" data-test="slot-form" phx-submit="select_slot" > <.input field={@slot_form[:scheduled_date]} type="date" label="Date" /> <.input field={@slot_form[:start_time]} type="time" label="Start time" />
<.button phx-disable-with="Checking...">Continue
<.form :if={@step in [:confirm, :payment_declined]} for={@confirmation_form} id="confirmation-form" data-test="confirmation-form" phx-submit="confirm_booking" >

Cancellation policy: cancel or reschedule at least 24-hour ahead of your visit to avoid a late-cancellation fee.

<.input field={@confirmation_form[:policy_agreed]} type="checkbox" label="I agree to the cancellation policy" data-test="policy-agreement-checkbox" />

Please agree to the cancellation policy to continue.

<.button phx-disable-with="Booking..."> Confirm & pay {Money.format_cents(@lead.total_cents)}

defmodule CleanerCrmSpex.Story851.Criterion7222Spex do
  @moduledoc """
  Story 851 — Reschedule or cancel a visit within the policy
  Criterion 7222 — Client reschedules a visit from the portal

  Assumes `PortalLive.Visit` at `/portal/visits/:id` exposes a
  reschedule form (`[data-test='reschedule-form']`, fields
  `visit[date]` and `visit[start_time]`) that updates the visit's own
  schedule in place.
  """

  use CleanerCrmSpex.Case

  alias CleanerCrmSpex.Fixtures

  spex "a client reschedules an upcoming visit from the portal" do
    scenario "client reschedules a visit from the portal" do
      given_ "the owner is logged in with an active account", context do
        user = Fixtures.user_fixture()
        scope = Fixtures.user_scope_fixture(user)
        account = Fixtures.account_fixture(scope)

        {:ok, Map.merge(context, %{user: user, scope: scope, account: account})}
      end

      given_ "I have an upcoming visit well within the notice window", context do
        client = Fixtures.client_fixture(context.scope)

        job =
          Fixtures.job_fixture(context.scope, client, %{
            scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 7),
            start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
            end_time: ~T[12:00:00]
          })

        portal_conn = Fixtures.portal_session_fixture(client)

        {:ok, Map.merge(context, %{client: client, job: job, portal_conn: portal_conn})}
      end

      when_ "I reschedule it to a new date and time", context do
        {:ok, visit_live, _html} =
          live(context.portal_conn, ~p"/portal/visits/#{context.job.id}")

        visit_live
        |> form("[data-test='reschedule-form']",
          visit: %{date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 10), start_time: "14:00"}
        )
        |> render_submit()

        {:ok, Map.put(context, :visit_live, visit_live)}
      end

      then_ "the visit shows the new date and time", context do
        assert render(context.visit_live) =~ "2:00 PM"

        {:ok, context}
      end
    end
  end
end

defmodule CleanerCrmWeb.PortalLive.VisitTest do
  use CleanerCrmTest.ConnCase, async: true

  import Phoenix.LiveViewTest
  import CleanerCrm.UsersFixtures
  import CleanerCrm.ClientsFixtures

  alias CleanerCrm.Accounts
  alias CleanerCrm.Portal
  alias CleanerCrm.Scheduling
  alias CleanerCrm.Users.Scope

  defp owner_scope_fixture do
    user = user_fixture()
    scope = Scope.for_user(user)
    {:ok, account} = Accounts.create_account(scope, %{name: "Sparkle Co"})
    %{scope | active_account: account, active_account_id: account.id}
  end

  defp portal_conn(client) do
    build_conn()
    |> init_test_session(%{})
    |> put_session(:portal_client_id, client.id)
  end

  test "reschedules a visit to a new date and time" do
    scope = owner_scope_fixture()
    client = client_fixture(scope, %{name: "Morgan Blake"})

    {:ok, job} =
      Scheduling.create_job(scope, %{
        client_id: client.id,
        agreed_price_cents: 15_000,
        scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 7),
        start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
        end_time: ~T[12:00:00]
      })

    {:ok, visit_live, _html} = live(portal_conn(client), ~p"/portal/visits/#{job.id}")

    visit_live
    |> form("[data-test='reschedule-form']",
      visit: %{date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 10), start_time: "14:00"}
    )
    |> render_submit()

    assert render(visit_live) =~ "2:00 PM"
    assert has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='visit-price']", "$150.00")
  end

  test "cancelling inside the notice window shows the fee before confirming" do
    scope = owner_scope_fixture()

    {:ok, _policy} =
      Portal.set_cancellation_policy(scope, %{notice_window_hours: 48, late_fee_cents: 2_500})

    client = client_fixture(scope, %{name: "Morgan Blake"})

    {:ok, job} =
      Scheduling.create_job(scope, %{
        client_id: client.id,
        scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 1),
        start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
        end_time: ~T[12:00:00]
      })

    {:ok, visit_live, _html} = live(portal_conn(client), ~p"/portal/visits/#{job.id}")

    visit_live |> element("[data-test='cancel-visit-button']") |> render_click()
    assert has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='cancellation-fee-notice']", "$25.00")

    visit_live |> element("[data-test='confirm-cancel-button']") |> render_click()
    assert has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='cancellation-fee-charged']", "$25.00")
  end

  test "a completed visit offers no reschedule or cancel controls" do
    scope = owner_scope_fixture()
    client = client_fixture(scope, %{name: "Morgan Blake"})

    {:ok, job} =
      Scheduling.create_job(scope, %{
        client_id: client.id,
        scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), -1),
        start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
        end_time: ~T[12:00:00],
        status: :completed
      })

    {:ok, visit_live, _html} = live(portal_conn(client), ~p"/portal/visits/#{job.id}")

    refute has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='reschedule-form']")
    refute has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='cancel-visit-button']")
  end
end

    {:ok, visit_live, _html} = live(portal_conn(client), ~p"/portal/visits/#{job.id}")

    |> render_submit()

    assert render(visit_live) =~ "2:00 PM"
    assert has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='visit-price']", "$150.00")
  end

  test "cancelling inside the notice window shows the fee before confirming" do
    scope = owner_scope_fixture()

    {:ok, _policy} =
      Portal.set_cancellation_policy(scope, %{notice_window_hours: 48, late_fee_cents: 2_500})

    client = client_fixture(scope, %{name: "Morgan Blake"})

    {:ok, job} =
      Scheduling.create_job(scope, %{
        client_id: client.id,
        scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 1),
        start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
        end_time: ~T[12:00:00]
      })

    {:ok, visit_live, _html} = live(portal_conn(client), ~p"/portal/visits/#{job.id}")

    visit_live |> element("[data-test='cancel-visit-button']") |> render_click()
    assert has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='cancellation-fee-notice']", "$25.00")

    visit_live |> element("[data-test='confirm-cancel-button']") |> render_click()
    assert has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='cancellation-fee-charged']", "$25.00")
  end

  test "a completed visit offers no reschedule or cancel controls" do
    scope = owner_scope_fixture()
    client = client_fixture(scope, %{name: "Morgan Blake"})

    {:ok, job} =
      Scheduling.create_job(scope, %{
        client_id: client.id,
        scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), -1),
        start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
        end_time: ~T[12:00:00],
        status: :completed
      })

    {:ok, visit_live, _html} = live(portal_conn(client), ~p"/portal/visits/#{job.id}")

    refute has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='reschedule-form']")
    refute has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='cancel-visit-button']")
  end
end

defmodule CleanerCrm.PortalTest do
  use CleanerCrmTest.DataCase, async: true

  alias CleanerCrm.Accounts
  alias CleanerCrm.Billing
  alias CleanerCrm.Clients
  alias CleanerCrm.Portal
  alias CleanerCrm.Scheduling
  alias CleanerCrm.Users.Scope

  import CleanerCrm.UsersFixtures

  setup do
    owner = user_fixture()
    owner_scope = Scope.for_user(owner)
    {:ok, account} = Accounts.create_account(owner_scope, %{name: "Sparkle Co"})
    scope = %{owner_scope | active_account_id: account.id, active_account: account}

    {:ok, client} = Clients.create_client(scope, %{name: "A Client"})

    %{scope: scope, account: account, client: client}
  end

  defp job_fixture(scope, client, attrs) do
    {:ok, job} =
      Scheduling.create_job(
        scope,
        Enum.into(attrs, %{
          client_id: client.id,
          scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 7),
          start_time: ~T[09:00:00],
          end_time: ~T[11:00:00],
          status: :scheduled
        })
      )

    job
  end

  describe "create_portal_session/2 and access_portal/1" do
    test "a fresh token grants access to the client that issued it", %{client: client} do
      {:ok, session} = Portal.create_portal_session(client, %{})

      assert {:ok, client_id} = Portal.access_portal(session.token)
      assert client_id == client.id
    end
  end

  describe "access_portal/1 failure paths" do
    test "an expired session is refused", %{client: client} do
      {:ok, session} =
        Portal.create_portal_session(client, %{
          expires_at: DateTime.add(DateTime.utc_now(), -3600, :second)
        })

      assert {:error, :invalid} = Portal.access_portal(session.token)
    end

    test "an unknown token is refused" do
      assert {:error, :invalid} = Portal.access_portal("not-a-real-token")
    end
  end

  describe "list_upcoming_visits/1 and list_visit_history/1" do
    test "upcoming visits excludes completed and cancelled jobs", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      upcoming = job_fixture(scope, client, %{})
      completed = job_fixture(scope, client, %{status: :completed})
      {:ok, cancelled} = Scheduling.cancel_job(scope, job_fixture(scope, client, %{}))

      visits = Portal.list_upcoming_visits(client)

      assert Enum.map(visits, & &1.id) == [upcoming.id]
      refute Enum.any?(visits, &(&1.id == completed.id))
      refute Enum.any?(visits, &(&1.id == cancelled.id))
    end

    test "visit history only includes completed jobs", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job_fixture(scope, client, %{})
      completed = job_fixture(scope, client, %{status: :completed})

      history = Portal.list_visit_history(client)

      assert Enum.map(history, & &1.id) == [completed.id]
    end
  end

  describe "get_visit!/2" do
    test "fetches a visit belonging to the client", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job = job_fixture(scope, client, %{})

      assert Portal.get_visit!(client, job.id).id == job.id
    end

    test "raises when the job belongs to a different client", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      {:ok, other_client} = Clients.create_client(scope, %{name: "Someone Else"})
      job = job_fixture(scope, other_client, %{})

      assert_raise Ecto.NoResultsError, fn -> Portal.get_visit!(client, job.id) end
    end
  end

  describe "reschedule_visit/3" do
    test "moves the date/time while preserving price and cleaner", %{
      scope: scope,
      account: account,
      client: client
    } do
      cleaner = CleanerCrm.SchedulingFixtures.cleaner_fixture(scope, account)

      job =
        job_fixture(scope, client, %{
          cleaner_id: cleaner.id,
          agreed_price_cents: 15_000,
          start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
          end_time: ~T[12:00:00]
        })

      new_date = Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 10)

      assert {:ok, updated} =
               Portal.reschedule_visit(client, job, %{
                 "date" => Date.to_iso8601(new_date),
                 "start_time" => "14:00"
               })

      assert updated.scheduled_date == new_date
      assert updated.start_time == ~T[14:00:00]
      assert updated.end_time == ~T[16:00:00]
      assert updated.agreed_price_cents == 15_000
      assert updated.cleaner_id == cleaner.id
    end

    test "refuses to reschedule a completed visit", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job = job_fixture(scope, client, %{status: :completed})

      assert {:error, :not_modifiable} =
               Portal.reschedule_visit(client, job, %{
                 "date" => Date.to_iso8601(Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 10)),
                 "start_time" => "14:00"
               })
    end
  end

  describe "cancellation_fee_cents/2 and cancel_visit/2" do
    setup %{scope: scope} do

defmodule CleanerCrmWeb.Router do
  use CleanerCrmWeb, :router

  import CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth

  pipeline :browser do
    plug :accepts, ["html"]
    plug :fetch_session
    plug :fetch_live_flash
    plug :put_root_layout, html: {CleanerCrmWeb.Layouts, :root}
    plug :protect_from_forgery
    plug :put_secure_browser_headers
    plug :fetch_current_scope_for_user
  end

  pipeline :api do
    plug :accepts, ["json"]
  end

  # No `:protect_from_forgery` — unlike the GET-only public routes below
  # (which can just use `:browser`), `/pay/:token` accepts a POST from a
  # client with no session and no CSRF token (a mailed or shared link).
  # `:fetch_current_scope_for_user` still runs — the root layout reads
  # `@current_scope` unconditionally, and this plug assigns `nil` when
  # no one's logged in rather than requiring an authenticated visitor.
  pipeline :public do
    plug :accepts, ["html"]
    plug :fetch_session
    plug :fetch_flash
    plug :put_root_layout, html: {CleanerCrmWeb.Layouts, :root}
    plug :put_secure_browser_headers
    plug :fetch_current_scope_for_user
  end

  pipeline :webhook do
    plug :accepts, ["json"]
  end

  # Office-only controller routes (e.g. the payroll CSV export) layer
  # this on top of `:require_authenticated_user`; office-only
  # LiveViews use the equivalent `CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole`
  # on_mount hook instead, since a plug can't gate a live_session.
  pipeline :require_office_role do
    plug CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through :browser

    get "/", PageController, :home
  end

  # Other scopes may use custom stacks.
  # scope "/api", CleanerCrmWeb do
  #   pipe_through :api
  # end

  # Enable LiveDashboard and Swoosh mailbox preview in development
  if Application.compile_env(:cleaner_crm, :dev_routes) do
    # If you want to use the LiveDashboard in production, you should put
    # it behind authentication and allow only admins to access it.
    # If your application does not have an admins-only section yet,
    # you can use Plug.BasicAuth to set up some basic authentication
    # as long as you are also using SSL (which you should anyway).
    import Phoenix.LiveDashboard.Router

    scope "/dev" do
      pipe_through :browser

      live_dashboard "/dashboard", metrics: CleanerCrmWeb.Telemetry
      forward "/mailbox", Plug.Swoosh.MailboxPreview
    end
  end

  ## Authentication routes

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated_user]

    live_session :require_authenticated_user,
      on_mount: [{CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :require_authenticated}] do
      live "/users/settings", UserLive.Settings, :edit
      live "/users/settings/confirm-email/:token", UserLive.Settings, :confirm_email

      live "/accounts", AccountLive.Index, :index
      live "/accounts/new", AccountLive.Form, :new
      live "/accounts/:id/edit", AccountLive.Form, :edit
      live "/accounts/picker", AccountLive.Picker, :index
      live "/accounts/:id", AccountLive.Manage, :show
      live "/accounts/:id/manage", AccountLive.Manage, :show
      live "/accounts/:id/members", AccountLive.Members, :show
      live "/accounts/:id/invitations", AccountLive.Invitations, :show

      live "/integrations", IntegrationLive.Index, :index

      live "/field", FieldLive.Today, :index
      live "/field/jobs/:id", FieldLive.Job, :show
    end

    # Office-only surfaces: dispatch, payroll, quality, invoicing,
    # clients, quotes, reminders, and the audit trail. Gated to
    # owners/admins by `CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole` — a cleaner
    # is redirected to `/field` instead. See that module for why it's
    # a separate `live_session` from the one above.
    live_session :require_office_role,
      on_mount: [
        {CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :require_authenticated},
        {CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole, :default}
      ] do
      live "/clients", ClientLive.Index, :index
      live "/clients/new", ClientLive.Index, :new
      live "/clients/:id/edit", ClientLive.Show, :edit
      live "/clients/:id/properties/new", ClientLive.Show, :new_client_property
      live "/clients/:id", ClientLive.Show, :show
      live "/properties/new", ClientLive.Show, :new_property
      live "/properties/:id/edit", ClientLive.Show, :edit_property
      live "/properties/:id", ClientLive.Show, :show_property

      live "/schedule", ScheduleLive.Index, :index
      live "/schedule/plans/new", ScheduleLive.PlanLive, :new
      live "/schedule/plans/:id/edit", ScheduleLive.PlanLive, :edit
      live "/schedule/jobs/new", ScheduleLive.JobLive, :new
      live "/schedule/jobs/:id/assign", ScheduleLive.JobLive, :assign
      live "/schedule/jobs/:id", ScheduleLive.JobLive, :show
      live "/schedule/cleaners/new", ScheduleLive.CleanerLive, :new
      live "/schedule/cleaners/:id", ScheduleLive.CleanerLive, :show
      live "/schedule/cleaners/:cleaner_id/time-off/new", ScheduleLive.AvailabilityLive, :new

      live "/audit", AuditLive, :index

      live "/quotes", QuoteLive.Index, :index
      live "/quotes/rate-card", QuoteLive.RateCard, :edit
      live "/quotes/new", QuoteLive.Builder, :new
      live "/quotes/:id", QuoteLive.Builder, :show

      live "/quality", QualityLive.Review, :index
      live "/quality/scorecards", QualityLive.Scorecards, :index
      live "/quality/templates", QualityLive.Templates, :index
      live "/quality/templates/new", QualityLive.Templates, :new
      live "/quality/templates/:id/edit", QualityLive.Templates, :edit
      live "/quality/:job_id", QualityLive.Review, :show

      live "/timesheets", TimesheetLive, :index

      live "/invoices", InvoiceLive.Index, :index
      live "/invoices/:id", InvoiceLive.Show, :show

      live "/reminders", ReminderLive, :index
    end

    post "/users/update-password", UserSessionController, :update_password
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated_user, :require_office_role]

    get "/timesheets/export", TimesheetExportController, :show
  end

  scope "/integrations/oauth", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated_user]

    get "/:provider", IntegrationsController, :request
    get "/callback/:provider", IntegrationsController, :callback
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    live_session :current_user,
      on_mount: [{CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :mount_current_scope}] do
      live "/users/register", UserLive.Registration, :new
      live "/users/log-in", UserLive.Login, :new
      live "/users/log-in/:token", UserLive.Confirmation, :new
      live "/invitations/accept/:token", InvitationsLive.Accept, :new
    end

    post "/users/log-in", UserSessionController, :create
    delete "/users/log-out", UserSessionController, :delete

    # Public confirm/reschedule links a client reaches from their
    # reminder — no login, so `:browser` (not `:require_authenticated_user`)
    # like the routes above. Plain `:browser`, not `:public`, so
    # `fetch_current_scope_for_user` still assigns `current_scope` for
    # the root layout.
    get "/reminders/confirm/:token", ReminderController, :confirm
    get "/reminders/reschedule/:token", ReminderController, :reschedule
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through :public

    get "/pay/:token", PaymentController, :show
    post "/pay/:token", PaymentController, :create
  end

  scope "/webhooks", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through :webhook

    post "/stripe", StripeWebhookController, :create
    post "/twilio", TwilioWebhookController, :status
  end

  # Reviews (story 853): the public token-link review page needs no
  # login — mirrors `/invitations/accept/:token`'s `:current_user`
  # live_session so `current_scope` still mounts for the root layout —
  # while the owner's review inbox is office-only, gated the same way
  # as the other office surfaces above.
  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    live_session :reviews_public,
      on_mount: [{CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :mount_current_scope}] do
      live "/reviews/:token", ReviewLive.Public, :show
    end
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated_user]

    live_session :reviews_office,
      on_mount: [
        {CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :require_authenticated},
        {CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole, :default}
      ] do
      live "/reviews", ReviewLive.Index, :index
    end
  end

  # Portal (client magic-link) — no user auth. `/portal/access/:token`
  # exchanges a mailed/booking-issued token for a portal session
  # (plain `:browser`, like the reminder confirm/reschedule links
  # above, so `fetch_session`/`fetch_current_scope_for_user` still
  # run); every other portal route sits behind
  # `CleanerCrmWeb.PortalAuth`'s own session check instead.
  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    get "/portal/access/:token", PortalController, :access

    live_session :portal,
      on_mount: [{CleanerCrmWeb.PortalAuth, :require_client}] do
      live "/portal", PortalLive.Home, :index
      live "/portal/visits/:id", PortalLive.Visit, :show
      live "/portal/invoices", PortalLive.Invoices, :index
    end
  end

  # Public booking funnel (stories 848/849) — no user auth, plain
  # `:browser` (like the reminder/reviews/portal public routes above)
  # so `current_scope` still mounts for the root layout. Both routes
  # share one view module, `BookingLive.Quote` — see its moduledoc for
  # why `BookingLive.Accept` isn't routed on its own.
  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    live_session :public_booking,
      on_mount: [{CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :mount_current_scope}] do
      live "/book", BookingLive.Quote, :new
      live "/book/accept/:token", BookingLive.Quote, :accept
    end
  end
end

defmodule CleanerCrmWeb.QuoteLive.RateCard do @moduledoc """ Owner-only management of the account's booking rate card (story 848): base per-room/per-sqft/hourly rates, recurring-frequency discounts, and named add-on prices — the same `CleanerCrm.Quoting.RateCard` fields the public instant-quote calculator (`CleanerCrmWeb.BookingLive.Quote`, at `/book`) reads. Before this page existed, an owner had no UI path to set them; only a direct database edit reached the frequency-discount and add-on fields (see `CleanerCrmWeb.QuoteLive.Builder`, which edits only the four base rates, in raw cents, alongside building a quote — left as-is since story 835's own spex drives that form). Base rates and add-on prices are entered in dollars and converted to cents before they ever reach the changeset — `RateCard` itself only stores integer cents — mirroring `CleanerCrmWeb.ScheduleLive.JobFormComponent`'s pay-rate inputs. Frequency discounts are plain percents, cast directly. `add_on_rates_cents` is a bare string-keyed map rather than an embedded schema, so it can't use `inputs_for`'s sort/drop convention. Its rows are tracked here as socket state (`@add_on_rows`, each with an id stable across edits so removing one row never renumbers another) and folded into the changeset's `add_on_rates_cents` attr on every change. ## Route * `/quotes/rate-card` (`:edit`) — office-only, gated the same as every other `/quotes` route. ## Dependencies - `CleanerCrm.Quoting` """ use CleanerCrmWeb, :live_view alias CleanerCrm.Quoting alias CleanerCrm.Quoting.RateCard @impl true def render(assigns) do ~H""" <.header> Booking Rate Card <:subtitle>Prices the public instant-quote calculator at /book uses <:actions> <.button navigate={~p"/quotes"} class="btn-sm btn-ghost">Back to Quotes <.form for={@form} id="rate-card-form" data-test="rate-card-form" phx-change="validate" phx-submit="save" >

Base rates

<.input type="number" step="0.01" min="0" name="rate_card[per_room_bedroom_rate]" id={@form[:per_room_bedroom_rate_cents].id} label="Per bedroom ($)" value={@rate_inputs.per_room_bedroom_rate} errors={field_errors(@form[:per_room_bedroom_rate_cents])} data-test="per-room-bedroom-rate-input" /> <.input type="number" step="0.01" min="0" name="rate_card[per_room_bathroom_rate]" id={@form[:per_room_bathroom_rate_cents].id} label="Per bathroom ($)" value={@rate_inputs.per_room_bathroom_rate} errors={field_errors(@form[:per_room_bathroom_rate_cents])} data-test="per-room-bathroom-rate-input" /> <.input type="number" step="0.01" min="0" name="rate_card[per_sqft_rate]" id={@form[:per_sqft_rate_cents].id} label="Per square foot ($)" value={@rate_inputs.per_sqft_rate} errors={field_errors(@form[:per_sqft_rate_cents])} data-test="per-sqft-rate-input" /> <.input type="number" step="0.01" min="0" name="rate_card[hourly_rate]" id={@form[:hourly_rate_cents].id} label="Hourly ($)" value={@rate_inputs.hourly_rate} errors={field_errors(@form[:hourly_rate_cents])} data-test="hourly-rate-input" />

Frequency discounts

Percent off the one-time subtotal for a recurring booking. Leave blank for no discount.

<.input field={@form[:weekly_discount_percent]} type="number" min="0" max="100" label="Weekly (%)" data-test="weekly-discount-input" /> <.input field={@form[:biweekly_discount_percent]} type="number" min="0" max="100" label="Bi-weekly (%)" data-test="biweekly-discount-input" /> <.input field={@form[:monthly_discount_percent]} type="number" min="0" max="100" label="Monthly (%)" data-test="monthly-discount-input" />

Add-ons

Named extras a client can add to their instant quote (e.g. "Inside fridge").

<.input type="text" name={"rate_card[add_ons][#{row.id}][name]"} id={"rate-card-add-on-#{row.id}-name"} label="Name" value={row.name} data-test={"add-on-name-input-#{row.id}"} /> <.input type="number" step="0.01" min="0" name={"rate_card[add_ons][#{row.id}][dollars]"} id={"rate-card-add-on-#{row.id}-dollars"} label="Price ($)" value={row.dollars} data-test={"add-on-price-input-#{row.id}"} />

{msg}

<.button phx-disable-with="Saving..." variant="primary" data-test="save-rate-card-button"> Save Rate Card
""" end @impl true def mount(_params, _session, socket) do scope = socket.assigns.current_scope rate_card = Quoting.get_or_create_rate_card(scope) {:ok, socket |> assign(:page_title, "Booking Rate Card") |> assign(:rate_card, rate_card) |> assign(:rate_inputs, rate_inputs(rate_card)) |> assign(:add_on_rows, add_on_rows(rate_card)) |> assign(:next_row_id, map_size(rate_card.add_on_rates_cents)) |> assign(:form, to_form(Quoting.change_rate_card(scope, rate_card), as: :rate_card))} end @impl true def handle_event("validate", %{"rate_card" => params}, socket) do {:noreply, apply_params(socket, params, :validate)} end def handle_event("save", %{"rate_card" => params}, socket) do %{current_scope: scope, rate_card: rate_card} = socket.assigns {attrs, rate_inputs, add_on_rows} = build_attrs(socket, params) case Quoting.update_rate_card(scope, rate_card, attrs) do {:ok, updated} -> {:noreply, socket |> put_flash(:info, "Rate card updated.") |> assign(:rate_card, updated) |> assign(:rate_inputs, rate_inputs(updated)) |> assign(:add_on_rows, add_on_rows(updated)) |> assign(:next_row_id, map_size(updated.add_on_rates_cents)) |> assign(:form, to_form(Quoting.change_rate_card(scope, updated), as: :rate_card))} {:error, changeset} -> {:noreply, socket |> assign(:rate_inputs, rate_inputs) |> assign(:add_on_rows, add_on_rows) |> assign(:form, to_form(changeset, as: :rate_card))} end end def handle_event("add_add_on", _params, socket) do row = %{id: socket.assigns.next_row_id, name: "", dollars: ""} {:noreply, socket |> update(:add_on_rows, &(&1 ++ [row])) |> update(:next_row_id, &(&1 + 1))} end def handle_event("remove_add_on", %{"row_id" => row_id}, socket) do row_id = String.to_integer(row_id) {:noreply, update(socket, :add_on_rows, &Enum.reject(&1, fn row -> row.id == row_id end))} end defp apply_params(socket, params, action) do {attrs, rate_inputs, add_on_rows} = build_attrs(socket, params) changeset = socket.assigns.current_scope |> Quoting.change_rate_card(socket.assigns.rate_card, attrs) |> Map.put(:action, action) socket |> assign(:rate_inputs, rate_inputs) |> assign(:add_on_rows, add_on_rows) |> assign(:form, to_form(changeset, as: :rate_card)) end # Builds the changeset attrs (dollar inputs converted to cents, # add-on rows folded into `add_on_rates_cents`) alongside the raw # dollar strings and add-on rows to redisplay — the same three # values both `validate` and `save` need, so both event handlers # (`apply_params/3` for the former, `save`'s own handler for the # latter) go through here. defp build_attrs(socket, params) do rate_inputs = %{ per_room_bedroom_rate: Map.get(params, "per_room_bedroom_rate", ""), per_room_bathroom_rate: Map.get(params, "per_room_bathroom_rate", ""), per_sqft_rate: Map.get(params, "per_sqft_rate", ""), hourly_rate: Map.get(params, "hourly_rate", "") } add_on_rows = sync_add_on_rows(socket.assigns.add_on_rows, Map.get(params, "add_ons", %{})) attrs = %{ "per_room_bedroom_rate_cents" => dollars_to_cents(rate_inputs.per_room_bedroom_rate), "per_room_bathroom_rate_cents" => dollars_to_cents(rate_inputs.per_room_bathroom_rate), "per_sqft_rate_cents" => dollars_to_cents(rate_inputs.per_sqft_rate), "hourly_rate_cents" => dollars_to_cents(rate_inputs.hourly_rate), "weekly_discount_percent" => Map.get(params, "weekly_discount_percent"), "biweekly_discount_percent" => Map.get(params, "biweekly_discount_percent"), "monthly_discount_percent" => Map.get(params, "monthly_discount_percent"), "add_on_rates_cents" => add_on_rates_cents(add_on_rows) } {attrs, rate_inputs, add_on_rows} end defp sync_add_on_rows(rows, add_ons_params) do Enum.map(rows, fn row -> case Map.get(add_ons_params, to_string(row.id)) do %{"name" => name, "dollars" => dollars} -> %{row | name: name, dollars: dollars} _ -> row end end) end # Only named rows are persisted — a row added but never given a # name is a placeholder, not "priced at $0". A named row with an # unparseable or blank price becomes `nil` cents, which # `RateCard.changeset/2` rejects with a validation error rather than # silently treating it as free. defp add_on_rates_cents(rows) do rows |> Enum.filter(fn row -> String.trim(row.name || "") != "" end) |> Map.new(fn row -> {String.trim(row.name), dollars_to_cents(row.dollars)} end) end defp rate_inputs(%RateCard{} = rate_card) do %{ per_room_bedroom_rate: cents_to_dollars(rate_card.per_room_bedroom_rate_cents), per_room_bathroom_rate: cents_to_dollars(rate_card.per_room_bathroom_rate_cents), per_sqft_rate: cents_to_dollars(rate_card.per_sqft_rate_cents), hourly_rate: cents_to_dollars(rate_card.hourly_rate_cents) } end defp add_on_rows(%RateCard{add_on_rates_cents: rates}) do rates |> Enum.sort_by(fn {name, _cents} -> name end) |> Enum.with_index() |> Enum.map(fn {{name, cents}, index} -> %{id: index, name: name, dollars: cents_to_dollars(cents)} end) end defp cents_to_dollars(nil), do: "" defp cents_to_dollars(cents), do: cents |> Decimal.new() |> Decimal.div(Decimal.new(100)) |> Decimal.to_string(:normal) # An unparseable dollar amount (or a blank input) becomes `nil` # rather than raising — base rates are optional at the schema level # (a `nil` rate means "not priced yet", see `RateCard`'s moduledoc), # so an invalid entry is left for `validate_number`/ # `validate_add_on_rates` to reject rather than crashing the form. defp dollars_to_cents(dollars) when is_binary(dollars) do case Decimal.parse(String.trim(dollars)) do {decimal, ""} -> decimal |> Decimal.mult(100) |> Decimal.round(0, :half_up) |> Decimal.to_integer() _ -> nil end end defp dollars_to_cents(_dollars), do: nil defp field_errors(field) do if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field), do: Enum.map(field.errors, &translate_error/1), else: [] end end

  @doc """
  The fee a client would be charged for cancelling `job` right now:
  the account's same-day fee if the visit is scheduled for today, its
  late fee if cancelling inside the notice window, otherwise zero.
  """
  def cancellation_fee_cents(%Client{} = client, %Job{} = job) do
    policy = get_cancellation_policy(client.account_id)
    fee_for(policy, job)
  end

  defp fee_for(%CancellationPolicy{} = policy, %Job{} = job) do
    cond do
      Date.compare(job.scheduled_date, Date.utc_today()) == :eq -> policy.same_day_fee_cents
      hours_until_visit(job) < policy.notice_window_hours -> policy.late_fee_cents
      true -> 0
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Cancels a visit, refusing with `{:error, :not_modifiable}` for one
  already completed or cancelled. Returns the fee charged alongside
  the updated visit — computed against the moment cancellation was
  requested, not looked up again afterward — and notifies the
  assigned cleaner of the cancellation.
  """
  def cancel_visit(%Client{} = client, %Job{} = job) do
    with :ok <- ensure_modifiable(job) do
      scope = account_scope(client)
      fee_cents = cancellation_fee_cents(client, job)

      with {:ok, updated} <- Scheduling.cancel_job(scope, job) do
        notify_schedule_change(scope, updated, "Visit cancelled by the client")
        {:ok, updated, fee_cents}
      end
    end
  end

  defp ensure_slot_in_future(date, start_time, now) do
    if slot_in_future?(date, start_time, now), do: :ok, else: {:error, :slot_in_past}
  end

  # Mirrors `CleanerCrm.Booking.Lead.slot_in_future?/2`'s own

  defp slot_in_future?(date, start_time, now) do
    case Date.compare(date, DateTime.to_date(now)) do
      :gt -> true
      :lt -> false
      :eq -> Time.compare(start_time, DateTime.to_time(now)) == :gt
    end
  end

defmodule CleanerCrmWeb.SettingsLive.BookingPolicy do @moduledoc """ Owner-only editor for the account's `CleanerCrm.Portal.CancellationPolicy` (story 851 follow-up, issue db25b304): the notice-window hours, the late and same-day cancellation fees, and the policy text shown to a client at booking and in their portal. Before this page existed, the only way to set any of it was a direct database edit. Fees are entered in dollars and converted to cents before they ever reach the changeset — `CancellationPolicy` itself only stores integer cents — mirroring `CleanerCrmWeb.QuoteLive.RateCard`'s own rate inputs. An account with no saved policy yet edits the same fresh, unsaved, all-zero-fee default that `CleanerCrm.Portal.get_cancellation_policy/1` hands the portal itself — the portal keeps working with those defaults whether or not this page has ever been visited. ## Route * `/settings/booking` (`:edit`) — office-only, gated the same as every other office surface (`CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole`). ## Dependencies - `CleanerCrm.Portal` """ use CleanerCrmWeb, :live_view alias CleanerCrm.Portal alias CleanerCrm.Portal.CancellationPolicy @impl true def render(assigns) do ~H""" <.header> Cancellation Policy <:subtitle> Notice window and fees enforced on self-service reschedule/cancel in the client portal <.form for={@form} id="cancellation-policy-form" data-test="cancellation-policy-form" phx-change="validate" phx-submit="save" >
<.input field={@form[:notice_window_hours]} type="number" min="0" label="Notice window (hours)" data-test="notice-window-input" />

How much notice a client must give to cancel or reschedule free of the late fee.

<.input type="number" step="0.01" min="0" name="policy[late_fee]" id={@form[:late_fee_cents].id} label="Late cancellation fee ($)" value={@fee_inputs.late_fee} errors={field_errors(@form[:late_fee_cents])} data-test="late-fee-input" /> <.input type="number" step="0.01" min="0" name="policy[same_day_fee]" id={@form[:same_day_fee_cents].id} label="Same-day cancellation fee ($)" value={@fee_inputs.same_day_fee} errors={field_errors(@form[:same_day_fee_cents])} data-test="same-day-fee-input" />

Charged instead of the late fee when a visit is cancelled the same day it's scheduled.

<.input field={@form[:policy_text]} type="textarea" label="Policy text shown to clients" data-test="policy-text-input" />
<.button phx-disable-with="Saving..." variant="primary" data-test="save-cancellation-policy-button" > Save Policy
""" end @impl true def mount(_params, _session, socket) do scope = socket.assigns.current_scope policy = Portal.get_cancellation_policy(scope.active_account_id) {:ok, socket |> assign(:page_title, "Cancellation Policy") |> assign(:policy, policy) |> assign(:fee_inputs, fee_inputs(policy)) |> assign(:form, to_form(Portal.change_cancellation_policy(scope, policy), as: :policy))} end @impl true def handle_event("validate", %{"policy" => params}, socket) do {:noreply, apply_params(socket, params, :validate)} end def handle_event("save", %{"policy" => params}, socket) do %{current_scope: scope, policy: policy} = socket.assigns {attrs, fee_inputs} = build_attrs(params) case Portal.set_cancellation_policy(scope, attrs) do {:ok, updated} -> {:noreply, socket |> put_flash(:info, "Cancellation policy updated.") |> assign(:policy, updated) |> assign(:fee_inputs, fee_inputs(updated)) |> assign(:form, to_form(Portal.change_cancellation_policy(scope, updated), as: :policy))} {:error, changeset} -> {:noreply, socket |> assign(:fee_inputs, fee_inputs) |> assign(:form, to_form(changeset, as: :policy))} end end defp apply_params(socket, params, action) do {attrs, fee_inputs} = build_attrs(params) changeset = socket.assigns.current_scope |> Portal.change_cancellation_policy(socket.assigns.policy, attrs) |> Map.put(:action, action) socket |> assign(:fee_inputs, fee_inputs) |> assign(:form, to_form(changeset, as: :policy)) end # Builds the changeset attrs (dollar inputs converted to cents) # alongside the raw dollar strings to redisplay — the same pair # both `validate` and `save` need, so both event handlers go through # here, mirroring `CleanerCrmWeb.QuoteLive.RateCard#build_attrs/2`. defp build_attrs(params) do fee_inputs = %{ late_fee: Map.get(params, "late_fee", ""), same_day_fee: Map.get(params, "same_day_fee", "") } attrs = %{ "notice_window_hours" => Map.get(params, "notice_window_hours"), "late_fee_cents" => dollars_to_cents(fee_inputs.late_fee), "same_day_fee_cents" => dollars_to_cents(fee_inputs.same_day_fee), "policy_text" => Map.get(params, "policy_text") } {attrs, fee_inputs} end defp fee_inputs(%CancellationPolicy{} = policy) do %{ late_fee: cents_to_dollars(policy.late_fee_cents), same_day_fee: cents_to_dollars(policy.same_day_fee_cents) } end defp cents_to_dollars(nil), do: "" defp cents_to_dollars(cents), do: cents |> Decimal.new() |> Decimal.div(Decimal.new(100)) |> Decimal.to_string(:normal) # An unparseable dollar amount (or a blank input) becomes `nil` # rather than raising, left for `CancellationPolicy.changeset/2`'s # own `validate_required`/`validate_number` to reject. defp dollars_to_cents(dollars) when is_binary(dollars) do case Decimal.parse(String.trim(dollars)) do {decimal, ""} -> decimal |> Decimal.mult(100) |> Decimal.round(0, :half_up) |> Decimal.to_integer() _ -> nil end end defp dollars_to_cents(_dollars), do: nil defp field_errors(field) do if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field), do: Enum.map(field.errors, &translate_error/1), else: [] end end
