defmodule CleanerCrmWeb.Router do
  use CleanerCrmWeb, :router

  import CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth

  pipeline :browser do
    plug :accepts, ["html"]
    plug :fetch_session
    plug :fetch_live_flash
    plug :put_root_layout, html: {CleanerCrmWeb.Layouts, :root}
    plug :protect_from_forgery
    plug :put_secure_browser_headers
    plug :fetch_current_scope_for_user
  end

  pipeline :api do
    plug :accepts, ["json"]
  end

  # No `:protect_from_forgery` — unlike the GET-only public routes below
  # (which can just use `:browser`), `/pay/:token` accepts a POST from a
  # client with no session and no CSRF token (a mailed or shared link).
  # `:fetch_current_scope_for_user` still runs — the root layout reads
  # `@current_scope` unconditionally, and this plug assigns `nil` when
  # no one's logged in rather than requiring an authenticated visitor.
  pipeline :public do
    plug :accepts, ["html"]
    plug :fetch_session
    plug :fetch_flash
    plug :put_root_layout, html: {CleanerCrmWeb.Layouts, :root}
    plug :put_secure_browser_headers
    plug :fetch_current_scope_for_user
  end

  pipeline :webhook do
    plug :accepts, ["json"]
  end

  # Office-only controller routes (e.g. the payroll CSV export) layer
  # this on top of `:require_authenticated_user`; office-only
  # LiveViews use the equivalent `CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole`
  # on_mount hook instead, since a plug can't gate a live_session.
  pipeline :require_office_role do
    plug CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through :browser

    get "/", PageController, :home
  end

  # Other scopes may use custom stacks.
  # scope "/api", CleanerCrmWeb do
  #   pipe_through :api
  # end

  # Enable LiveDashboard and Swoosh mailbox preview in development
  if Application.compile_env(:cleaner_crm, :dev_routes) do
    # If you want to use the LiveDashboard in production, you should put
    # it behind authentication and allow only admins to access it.
    # If your application does not have an admins-only section yet,
    # you can use Plug.BasicAuth to set up some basic authentication
    # as long as you are also using SSL (which you should anyway).
    import Phoenix.LiveDashboard.Router

    scope "/dev" do
      pipe_through :browser

      live_dashboard "/dashboard", metrics: CleanerCrmWeb.Telemetry
      forward "/mailbox", Plug.Swoosh.MailboxPreview
    end
  end

  ## Authentication routes

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated_user]

    live_session :require_authenticated_user,
      on_mount: [{CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :require_authenticated}] do
      live "/users/settings", UserLive.Settings, :edit
      live "/users/settings/confirm-email/:token", UserLive.Settings, :confirm_email

      live "/accounts", AccountLive.Index, :index
      live "/accounts/new", AccountLive.Form, :new
      live "/accounts/:id/edit", AccountLive.Form, :edit
      live "/accounts/picker", AccountLive.Picker, :index
      live "/accounts/:id", AccountLive.Manage, :show
      live "/accounts/:id/manage", AccountLive.Manage, :show
      live "/accounts/:id/members", AccountLive.Members, :show
      live "/accounts/:id/invitations", AccountLive.Invitations, :show

      live "/integrations", IntegrationLive.Index, :index

      live "/field", FieldLive.Today, :index
      live "/field/jobs/:id", FieldLive.Job, :show
    end

    # Office-only surfaces: dispatch, payroll, quality, invoicing,
    # clients, quotes, reminders, and the audit trail. Gated to
    # owners/admins by `CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole` — a cleaner
    # is redirected to `/field` instead. See that module for why it's
    # a separate `live_session` from the one above.
    live_session :require_office_role,
      on_mount: [
        {CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :require_authenticated},
        {CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole, :default}
      ] do
      live "/clients", ClientLive.Index, :index
      live "/clients/new", ClientLive.Index, :new
      live "/clients/:id/edit", ClientLive.Show, :edit
      live "/clients/:id/properties/new", ClientLive.Show, :new_client_property
      live "/clients/:id", ClientLive.Show, :show
      live "/properties/new", ClientLive.Show, :new_property
      live "/properties/:id/edit", ClientLive.Show, :edit_property
      live "/properties/:id", ClientLive.Show, :show_property

      live "/schedule", ScheduleLive.Index, :index
      live "/schedule/plans/new", ScheduleLive.PlanLive, :new
      live "/schedule/plans/:id/edit", ScheduleLive.PlanLive, :edit
      live "/schedule/jobs/new", ScheduleLive.JobLive, :new
      live "/schedule/jobs/:id/assign", ScheduleLive.JobLive, :assign
      live "/schedule/jobs/:id", ScheduleLive.JobLive, :show
      live "/schedule/cleaners/new", ScheduleLive.CleanerLive, :new
      live "/schedule/cleaners/:id", ScheduleLive.CleanerLive, :show
      live "/schedule/cleaners/:cleaner_id/time-off/new", ScheduleLive.AvailabilityLive, :new

      live "/audit", AuditLive, :index

      live "/quotes", QuoteLive.Index, :index
      live "/quotes/rate-card", QuoteLive.RateCard, :edit
      live "/quotes/new", QuoteLive.Builder, :new
      live "/quotes/:id", QuoteLive.Builder, :show

      live "/quality", QualityLive.Review, :index
      live "/quality/scorecards", QualityLive.Scorecards, :index
      live "/quality/templates", QualityLive.Templates, :index
      live "/quality/templates/new", QualityLive.Templates, :new
      live "/quality/templates/:id/edit", QualityLive.Templates, :edit
      live "/quality/:job_id", QualityLive.Review, :show

      live "/timesheets", TimesheetLive, :index

      live "/invoices", InvoiceLive.Index, :index
      live "/invoices/:id", InvoiceLive.Show, :show

      live "/reminders", ReminderLive, :index
    end

    post "/users/update-password", UserSessionController, :update_password
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated_user, :require_office_role]

    get "/timesheets/export", TimesheetExportController, :show
  end

  scope "/integrations/oauth", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated_user]

    get "/:provider", IntegrationsController, :request
    get "/callback/:provider", IntegrationsController, :callback
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    live_session :current_user,
      on_mount: [{CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :mount_current_scope}] do
      live "/users/register", UserLive.Registration, :new
      live "/users/log-in", UserLive.Login, :new
      live "/users/log-in/:token", UserLive.Confirmation, :new
      live "/invitations/accept/:token", InvitationsLive.Accept, :new
    end

    post "/users/log-in", UserSessionController, :create
    delete "/users/log-out", UserSessionController, :delete

    # Public confirm/reschedule links a client reaches from their
    # reminder — no login, so `:browser` (not `:require_authenticated_user`)
    # like the routes above. Plain `:browser`, not `:public`, so
    # `fetch_current_scope_for_user` still assigns `current_scope` for
    # the root layout.
    get "/reminders/confirm/:token", ReminderController, :confirm
    get "/reminders/reschedule/:token", ReminderController, :reschedule
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through :public

    get "/pay/:token", PaymentController, :show
    post "/pay/:token", PaymentController, :create
  end

  scope "/webhooks", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through :webhook

    post "/stripe", StripeWebhookController, :create
    post "/twilio", TwilioWebhookController, :status
  end

  # Reviews (story 853): the public token-link review page needs no
  # login — mirrors `/invitations/accept/:token`'s `:current_user`
  # live_session so `current_scope` still mounts for the root layout —
  # while the owner's review inbox is office-only, gated the same way
  # as the other office surfaces above.
  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    live_session :reviews_public,
      on_mount: [{CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :mount_current_scope}] do
      live "/reviews/:token", ReviewLive.Public, :show
    end
  end

  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated_user]

    live_session :reviews_office,
      on_mount: [
        {CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :require_authenticated},
        {CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole, :default}
      ] do
      live "/reviews", ReviewLive.Index, :index
    end
  end

  # Portal (client magic-link) — no user auth. `/portal/access/:token`
  # exchanges a mailed/booking-issued token for a portal session
  # (plain `:browser`, like the reminder confirm/reschedule links
  # above, so `fetch_session`/`fetch_current_scope_for_user` still
  # run); every other portal route sits behind
  # `CleanerCrmWeb.PortalAuth`'s own session check instead.
  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    get "/portal/access/:token", PortalController, :access

    live_session :portal,
      on_mount: [{CleanerCrmWeb.PortalAuth, :require_client}] do
      live "/portal", PortalLive.Home, :index
      live "/portal/visits/:id", PortalLive.Visit, :show
      live "/portal/invoices", PortalLive.Invoices, :index
    end
  end

  # Public booking funnel (stories 848/849) — no user auth, plain
  # `:browser` (like the reminder/reviews/portal public routes above)
  # so `current_scope` still mounts for the root layout. Both routes
  # share one view module, `BookingLive.Quote` — see its moduledoc for
  # why `BookingLive.Accept` isn't routed on its own.
  scope "/", CleanerCrmWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    live_session :public_booking,
      on_mount: [{CleanerCrmWeb.UserAuth, :mount_current_scope}] do
      live "/book", BookingLive.Quote, :new
      live "/book/accept/:token", BookingLive.Quote, :accept
    end
  end
end

defmodule CleanerCrmWeb.SettingsLive.BookingPolicy do @moduledoc """ Owner-only editor for the account's `CleanerCrm.Portal.CancellationPolicy` (story 851 follow-up, issue db25b304): the notice-window hours, the late and same-day cancellation fees, and the policy text shown to a client at booking and in their portal. Before this page existed, the only way to set any of it was a direct database edit. Fees are entered in dollars and converted to cents before they ever reach the changeset — `CancellationPolicy` itself only stores integer cents — mirroring `CleanerCrmWeb.QuoteLive.RateCard`'s own rate inputs. An account with no saved policy yet edits the same fresh, unsaved, all-zero-fee default that `CleanerCrm.Portal.get_cancellation_policy/1` hands the portal itself — the portal keeps working with those defaults whether or not this page has ever been visited. ## Route * `/settings/booking` (`:edit`) — office-only, gated the same as every other office surface (`CleanerCrmWeb.RequireOfficeRole`). ## Dependencies - `CleanerCrm.Portal` """ use CleanerCrmWeb, :live_view alias CleanerCrm.Portal alias CleanerCrm.Portal.CancellationPolicy @impl true def render(assigns) do ~H""" <.header> Cancellation Policy <:subtitle> Notice window and fees enforced on self-service reschedule/cancel in the client portal <.form for={@form} id="cancellation-policy-form" data-test="cancellation-policy-form" phx-change="validate" phx-submit="save" >
<.input field={@form[:notice_window_hours]} type="number" min="0" label="Notice window (hours)" data-test="notice-window-input" />

How much notice a client must give to cancel or reschedule free of the late fee.

<.input type="number" step="0.01" min="0" name="policy[late_fee]" id={@form[:late_fee_cents].id} label="Late cancellation fee ($)" value={@fee_inputs.late_fee} errors={field_errors(@form[:late_fee_cents])} data-test="late-fee-input" /> <.input type="number" step="0.01" min="0" name="policy[same_day_fee]" id={@form[:same_day_fee_cents].id} label="Same-day cancellation fee ($)" value={@fee_inputs.same_day_fee} errors={field_errors(@form[:same_day_fee_cents])} data-test="same-day-fee-input" />

Charged instead of the late fee when a visit is cancelled the same day it's scheduled.

<.input field={@form[:policy_text]} type="textarea" label="Policy text shown to clients" data-test="policy-text-input" />
<.button phx-disable-with="Saving..." variant="primary" data-test="save-cancellation-policy-button" > Save Policy
""" end @impl true def mount(_params, _session, socket) do scope = socket.assigns.current_scope policy = Portal.get_cancellation_policy(scope.active_account_id) {:ok, socket |> assign(:page_title, "Cancellation Policy") |> assign(:policy, policy) |> assign(:fee_inputs, fee_inputs(policy)) |> assign(:form, to_form(Portal.change_cancellation_policy(scope, policy), as: :policy))} end @impl true def handle_event("validate", %{"policy" => params}, socket) do {:noreply, apply_params(socket, params, :validate)} end def handle_event("save", %{"policy" => params}, socket) do %{current_scope: scope, policy: policy} = socket.assigns {attrs, fee_inputs} = build_attrs(params) case Portal.set_cancellation_policy(scope, attrs) do {:ok, updated} -> {:noreply, socket |> put_flash(:info, "Cancellation policy updated.") |> assign(:policy, updated) |> assign(:fee_inputs, fee_inputs(updated)) |> assign(:form, to_form(Portal.change_cancellation_policy(scope, updated), as: :policy))} {:error, changeset} -> {:noreply, socket |> assign(:fee_inputs, fee_inputs) |> assign(:form, to_form(changeset, as: :policy))} end end defp apply_params(socket, params, action) do {attrs, fee_inputs} = build_attrs(params) changeset = socket.assigns.current_scope |> Portal.change_cancellation_policy(socket.assigns.policy, attrs) |> Map.put(:action, action) socket |> assign(:fee_inputs, fee_inputs) |> assign(:form, to_form(changeset, as: :policy)) end # Builds the changeset attrs (dollar inputs converted to cents) # alongside the raw dollar strings to redisplay — the same pair # both `validate` and `save` need, so both event handlers go through # here, mirroring `CleanerCrmWeb.QuoteLive.RateCard#build_attrs/2`. defp build_attrs(params) do fee_inputs = %{ late_fee: Map.get(params, "late_fee", ""), same_day_fee: Map.get(params, "same_day_fee", "") } attrs = %{ "notice_window_hours" => Map.get(params, "notice_window_hours"), "late_fee_cents" => dollars_to_cents(fee_inputs.late_fee), "same_day_fee_cents" => dollars_to_cents(fee_inputs.same_day_fee), "policy_text" => Map.get(params, "policy_text") } {attrs, fee_inputs} end defp fee_inputs(%CancellationPolicy{} = policy) do %{ late_fee: cents_to_dollars(policy.late_fee_cents), same_day_fee: cents_to_dollars(policy.same_day_fee_cents) } end defp cents_to_dollars(nil), do: "" defp cents_to_dollars(cents), do: cents |> Decimal.new() |> Decimal.div(Decimal.new(100)) |> Decimal.to_string(:normal) # An unparseable dollar amount (or a blank input) becomes `nil` # rather than raising, left for `CancellationPolicy.changeset/2`'s # own `validate_required`/`validate_number` to reject. defp dollars_to_cents(dollars) when is_binary(dollars) do case Decimal.parse(String.trim(dollars)) do {decimal, ""} -> decimal |> Decimal.mult(100) |> Decimal.round(0, :half_up) |> Decimal.to_integer() _ -> nil end end defp dollars_to_cents(_dollars), do: nil defp field_errors(field) do if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field), do: Enum.map(field.errors, &translate_error/1), else: [] end end

test "refuses to reschedule a completed visit", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job = job_fixture(scope, client, %{status: :completed})

      assert {:error, :not_modifiable} =
               Portal.reschedule_visit(client, job, %{
                 "date" => Date.to_iso8601(Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 10)),
                 "start_time" => "14:00"
               })
    end

    test "refuses to reschedule to a date already in the past", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job = job_fixture(scope, client, %{})

      assert {:error, :slot_in_past} =
               Portal.reschedule_visit(client, job, %{
                 "date" => "2020-01-01",
                 "start_time" => "14:00"
               })

      unchanged = Portal.get_visit!(client, job.id)
      assert unchanged.scheduled_date == job.scheduled_date
      assert unchanged.start_time == job.start_time
    end

    test "refuses to reschedule to today once the chosen start time has already passed", %{
      scope: scope,
      client: client
    } do
      job = job_fixture(scope, client, %{})
      now = DateTime.new!(Date.utc_today(), ~T[15:00:00], "Etc/UTC")

      assert {:error, :slot_in_past} =
               Portal.reschedule_visit(
                 client,
                 job,
                 %{"date" => Date.to_iso8601(Date.utc_today()), "start_time" => "14:00"},
                 now
               )
    end

    test "allows rescheduling to later today when the start time is still ahead of now", %{
      scope: scope,
      client: client
    } do
      job = job_fixture(scope, client, %{})
      now = DateTime.new!(Date.utc_today(), ~T[10:00:00], "Etc/UTC")

      assert {:ok, updated} =
               Portal.reschedule_visit(
                 client,
                 job,
                 %{"date" => Date.to_iso8601(Date.utc_today()), "start_time" => "14:00"},
                 now
               )

      assert updated.scheduled_date == Date.utc_today()
      assert updated.start_time == ~T[14:00:00]
    end
  end

defmodule CleanerCrm.PortalTest do
  use CleanerCrmTest.DataCase, async: true

  alias CleanerCrm.Accounts
  alias CleanerCrm.Billing
  alias CleanerCrm.Clients
  alias CleanerCrm.Portal
  alias CleanerCrm.Scheduling
  alias CleanerCrm.Users.Scope

  import CleanerCrm.UsersFixtures

  setup do
    owner = user_fixture()
    owner_scope = Scope.for_user(owner)
    {:ok, account} = Accounts.create_account(owner_scope, %{name: "Sparkle Co"})
    scope = %{owner_scope | active_account_id: account.id, active_account: account}

    {:ok, client} = Clients.create_client(scope, %{name: "A Client"})

    %{scope: scope, account: account, client: client}
  end

  defp job_fixture(scope, client, attrs) do
    {:ok, job} =
      Scheduling.create_job(
        scope,
        Enum.into(attrs, %{
          client_id: client.id,
          scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 7),
          start_time: ~T[09:00:00],
          end_time: ~T[11:00:00],
          status: :scheduled
        })
      )

    job
  end

  describe "create_portal_session/2 and access_portal/1" do
    test "a fresh token grants access to the client that issued it", %{client: client} do
      {:ok, session} = Portal.create_portal_session(client, %{})

      assert {:ok, client_id} = Portal.access_portal(session.token)
      assert client_id == client.id
    end
  end

  describe "access_portal/1 failure paths" do
    test "an expired session is refused", %{client: client} do
      {:ok, session} =
        Portal.create_portal_session(client, %{
          expires_at: DateTime.add(DateTime.utc_now(), -3600, :second)
        })

      assert {:error, :invalid} = Portal.access_portal(session.token)
    end

    test "an unknown token is refused" do
      assert {:error, :invalid} = Portal.access_portal("not-a-real-token")
    end
  end

  describe "list_upcoming_visits/1 and list_visit_history/1" do
    test "upcoming visits excludes completed and cancelled jobs", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      upcoming = job_fixture(scope, client, %{})
      completed = job_fixture(scope, client, %{status: :completed})
      {:ok, cancelled} = Scheduling.cancel_job(scope, job_fixture(scope, client, %{}))

      visits = Portal.list_upcoming_visits(client)

      assert Enum.map(visits, & &1.id) == [upcoming.id]
      refute Enum.any?(visits, &(&1.id == completed.id))
      refute Enum.any?(visits, &(&1.id == cancelled.id))
    end

    test "visit history only includes completed jobs", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job_fixture(scope, client, %{})
      completed = job_fixture(scope, client, %{status: :completed})

      history = Portal.list_visit_history(client)

      assert Enum.map(history, & &1.id) == [completed.id]
    end
  end

  describe "get_visit!/2" do
    test "fetches a visit belonging to the client", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job = job_fixture(scope, client, %{})

      assert Portal.get_visit!(client, job.id).id == job.id
    end

    test "raises when the job belongs to a different client", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      {:ok, other_client} = Clients.create_client(scope, %{name: "Someone Else"})
      job = job_fixture(scope, other_client, %{})

      assert_raise Ecto.NoResultsError, fn -> Portal.get_visit!(client, job.id) end
    end
  end

  describe "reschedule_visit/3" do
    test "moves the date/time while preserving price and cleaner", %{
      scope: scope,
      account: account,
      client: client
    } do
      cleaner = CleanerCrm.SchedulingFixtures.cleaner_fixture(scope, account)

      job =
        job_fixture(scope, client, %{
          cleaner_id: cleaner.id,
          agreed_price_cents: 15_000,
          start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
          end_time: ~T[12:00:00]
        })

      new_date = Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 10)

      assert {:ok, updated} =
               Portal.reschedule_visit(client, job, %{
                 "date" => Date.to_iso8601(new_date),
                 "start_time" => "14:00"
               })

      assert updated.scheduled_date == new_date
      assert updated.start_time == ~T[14:00:00]
      assert updated.end_time == ~T[16:00:00]
      assert updated.agreed_price_cents == 15_000
      assert updated.cleaner_id == cleaner.id
    end

    test "refuses to reschedule a completed visit", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job = job_fixture(scope, client, %{status: :completed})

      assert {:error, :not_modifiable} =
               Portal.reschedule_visit(client, job, %{
                 "date" => Date.to_iso8601(Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 10)),
                 "start_time" => "14:00"
               })
    end
  end

  describe "cancellation_fee_cents/2 and cancel_visit/2" do
    setup %{scope: scope} do
      {:ok, _policy} =
        Portal.set_cancellation_policy(scope, %{
          notice_window_hours: 48,
          late_fee_cents: 2_500,
          same_day_fee_cents: 5_000
        })

      :ok
    end

    test "no fee outside the notice window", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job = job_fixture(scope, client, %{scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 5)})
      assert Portal.cancellation_fee_cents(client, job) == 0
    end

    test "the late fee inside the notice window", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job =
        job_fixture(scope, client, %{
          scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 1),
          start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
          end_time: ~T[12:00:00]
        })

      assert Portal.cancellation_fee_cents(client, job) == 2_500
    end

    test "the maximum fee for a same-day cancellation", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job =
        job_fixture(scope, client, %{
          scheduled_date: Date.utc_today(),
          start_time: ~T[18:00:00],
          end_time: ~T[20:00:00]
        })

      assert Portal.cancellation_fee_cents(client, job) == 5_000
    end

    test "cancels the visit and reports the fee charged", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job =
        job_fixture(scope, client, %{
          scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 1),
          start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
          end_time: ~T[12:00:00]
        })

      assert {:ok, updated, 2_500} = Portal.cancel_visit(client, job)
      assert updated.status == :cancelled
    end

    test "refuses to cancel an already-cancelled visit", %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job = job_fixture(scope, client, %{})
      {:ok, _updated, _fee} = Portal.cancel_visit(client, job)

      assert {:error, :not_modifiable} = Portal.cancel_visit(client, %{job | status: :cancelled})
    end
  end

  describe "get_cancellation_policy/1" do
    test "defaults to a 24-hour window with no fees when unset", %{account: account} do
      policy = Portal.get_cancellation_policy(account.id)

      assert policy.notice_window_hours == 24
      assert policy.late_fee_cents == 0
      assert policy.same_day_fee_cents == 0
    end
  end

  describe "invoices and payment" do
    setup %{scope: scope, client: client} do
      job = job_fixture(scope, client, %{status: :completed, agreed_price_cents: 15_000})
      {:ok, invoice} = Billing.create_invoice(scope, %{job_id: job.id, amount_cents: 15_000})
      %{job: job, invoice: invoice}
    end

    test "lists only this client's invoices", %{scope: scope, client: client, invoice: invoice} do
      {:ok, other_client} = Clients.create_client(scope, %{name: "Someone Else"})
      other_job = job_fixture(scope, other_client, %{status: :completed})

      {:ok, _other_invoice} =
        Billing.create_invoice(scope, %{job_id: other_job.id, amount_cents: 1})

      invoices = Portal.list_invoices(client)

      assert Enum.map(invoices, & &1.id) == [invoice.id]
    end

    test "pays an invoice, saves the card, and records a tip for the assigned cleaner", %{
      scope: scope,
      account: account,
      client: client,
      job: job,
      invoice: invoice
    } do
      cleaner = CleanerCrm.SchedulingFixtures.cleaner_fixture(scope, account)
      {:ok, job} = Scheduling.assign_cleaner(scope, job, cleaner.id)
      invoice = %{invoice | job: job}

      assert {:ok, updated_invoice} =
               Portal.pay_invoice(client, invoice, %{
                 "card_token" => "pm_card_visa",
                 "save_card" => "true",
                 "tip_cents" => "1000"
               })

      assert updated_invoice.status == :charge_pending

      reloaded_client = Portal.get_client!(client.id)
      assert reloaded_client.card_on_file

      period = CleanerCrm.TimeTracking.current_pay_period(scope)
      assert Portal.tip_cents_for_cleaner(scope, cleaner.id, period) == 1_000
    end

    test "paying without a tip adds nothing to the cleaner's earnings", %{
      scope: scope,
      account: account,
      client: client,
      job: job,
      invoice: invoice
    } do
      cleaner = CleanerCrm.SchedulingFixtures.cleaner_fixture(scope, account)
      {:ok, job} = Scheduling.assign_cleaner(scope, job, cleaner.id)
      invoice = %{invoice | job: job}

      assert {:ok, _updated_invoice} =
               Portal.pay_invoice(client, invoice, %{"card_token" => "pm_card_visa"})

      period = CleanerCrm.TimeTracking.current_pay_period(scope)
      assert Portal.tip_cents_for_cleaner(scope, cleaner.id, period) == 0
    end
  end
end

defmodule CleanerCrmWeb.PortalLive.VisitTest do
  use CleanerCrmTest.ConnCase, async: true

  import Phoenix.LiveViewTest
  import CleanerCrm.UsersFixtures
  import CleanerCrm.ClientsFixtures

  alias CleanerCrm.Accounts
  alias CleanerCrm.Portal
  alias CleanerCrm.Scheduling
  alias CleanerCrm.Users.Scope

  defp owner_scope_fixture do
    user = user_fixture()
    scope = Scope.for_user(user)
    {:ok, account} = Accounts.create_account(scope, %{name: "Sparkle Co"})
    %{scope | active_account: account, active_account_id: account.id}
  end

  defp portal_conn(client) do
    build_conn()
    |> init_test_session(%{})
    |> put_session(:portal_client_id, client.id)
  end

  test "reschedules a visit to a new date and time" do
    scope = owner_scope_fixture()
    client = client_fixture(scope, %{name: "Morgan Blake"})

    {:ok, job} =
      Scheduling.create_job(scope, %{
        client_id: client.id,
        agreed_price_cents: 15_000,
        scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 7),
        start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
        end_time: ~T[12:00:00]
      })

    {:ok, visit_live, _html} = live(portal_conn(client), ~p"/portal/visits/#{job.id}")

    visit_live
    |> form("[data-test='reschedule-form']",
      visit: %{date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 10), start_time: "14:00"}
    )
    |> render_submit()

    assert render(visit_live) =~ "2:00 PM"
    assert has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='visit-price']", "$150.00")
  end

  test "cancelling inside the notice window shows the fee before confirming" do
    scope = owner_scope_fixture()

    {:ok, _policy} =
      Portal.set_cancellation_policy(scope, %{notice_window_hours: 48, late_fee_cents: 2_500})

    client = client_fixture(scope, %{name: "Morgan Blake"})

    {:ok, job} =
      Scheduling.create_job(scope, %{
        client_id: client.id,
        scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), 1),
        start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
        end_time: ~T[12:00:00]
      })

    {:ok, visit_live, _html} = live(portal_conn(client), ~p"/portal/visits/#{job.id}")

    visit_live |> element("[data-test='cancel-visit-button']") |> render_click()
    assert has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='cancellation-fee-notice']", "$25.00")

    visit_live |> element("[data-test='confirm-cancel-button']") |> render_click()
    assert has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='cancellation-fee-charged']", "$25.00")
  end

  test "a completed visit offers no reschedule or cancel controls" do
    scope = owner_scope_fixture()
    client = client_fixture(scope, %{name: "Morgan Blake"})

    {:ok, job} =
      Scheduling.create_job(scope, %{
        client_id: client.id,
        scheduled_date: Date.add(Date.utc_today(), -1),
        start_time: ~T[10:00:00],
        end_time: ~T[12:00:00],
        status: :completed
      })

    {:ok, visit_live, _html} = live(portal_conn(client), ~p"/portal/visits/#{job.id}")

    refute has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='reschedule-form']")
    refute has_element?(visit_live, "[data-test='cancel-visit-button']")
  end
end

defmodule CleanerCrmWeb.QuoteLive.RateCardTest do
  @moduledoc """
  Covers issue 29ca9136: the public `/book` instant-quote calculator
  prices from `CleanerCrm.Quoting.RateCard`'s base rates, frequency
  discounts, and add-on prices, but no owner UI ever set the discount
  or add-on fields (QA had to seed them via psql). No spex/BDD story
  owns this surface (story 835's own spex covers the narrower,
  cents-denominated rate-card form embedded in `QuoteLive.Builder`),
  so it's covered here instead.
  """

  use CleanerCrmTest.ConnCase, async: true

  import Phoenix.LiveViewTest
  import CleanerCrm.UsersFixtures

  alias CleanerCrm.Accounts
  alias CleanerCrm.Quoting
  alias CleanerCrm.Users.Scope

  defp scope_fixture do
    user = user_fixture()
    scope = Scope.for_user(user)

    {:ok, account} =
      Accounts.create_account(scope, %{name: "Sparkle Co #{System.unique_integer([:positive])}"})

    %{scope | active_account: account, active_account_id: account.id}
  end

  defp log_in(conn, scope), do: log_in_user(conn, scope.user)

  test "renders the current rate card's base rates, discounts, and add-ons", %{conn: conn} do
    scope = scope_fixture()

    {:ok, _rate_card} =
      Quoting.update_rate_card(scope, Quoting.get_or_create_rate_card(scope), %{
        per_room_bedroom_rate_cents: 3500,
        per_sqft_rate_cents: 12,
        hourly_rate_cents: 4000,
        weekly_discount_percent: 10,
        add_on_rates_cents: %{"inside_fridge" => 1500}
      })

    {:ok, lv, html} = live(log_in(conn, scope), ~p"/quotes/rate-card")

    assert html =~ "35"
    assert has_element?(lv, "[data-test='per-room-bedroom-rate-input']")
    assert has_element?(lv, "[data-test='weekly-discount-input']")
    assert has_element?(lv, "[data-test='add-on-row-0']")
    assert has_element?(lv, "[data-test='add-on-name-input-0']")
  end

  test "saves base rates and frequency discounts, converting dollars to cents", %{conn: conn} do
    scope = scope_fixture()
    {:ok, lv, _html} = live(log_in(conn, scope), ~p"/quotes/rate-card")

    lv
    |> form("[data-test='rate-card-form']",
      rate_card: %{
        per_room_bedroom_rate: "35.00",
        per_room_bathroom_rate: "20.00",
        per_sqft_rate: "0.12",
        hourly_rate: "40.00",
        weekly_discount_percent: "10",
        biweekly_discount_percent: "5",
        monthly_discount_percent: "15"
      }
    )
    |> render_submit()

    rate_card = Quoting.get_or_create_rate_card(scope)

    assert rate_card.per_room_bedroom_rate_cents == 3500
    assert rate_card.per_room_bathroom_rate_cents == 2000
    assert rate_card.per_sqft_rate_cents == 12
    assert rate_card.hourly_rate_cents == 4000
    assert rate_card.weekly_discount_percent == 10
    assert rate_card.biweekly_discount_percent == 5
    assert rate_card.monthly_discount_percent == 15
  end

  test "Add add-on control appends a blank row that can be named, priced, and saved", %{
    conn: conn
  } do
    scope = scope_fixture()
    {:ok, lv, _html} = live(log_in(conn, scope), ~p"/quotes/rate-card")

    refute has_element?(lv, "[data-test='add-on-row-0']")

    lv |> element("[data-test='add-add-on-button']") |> render_click()

    assert has_element?(lv, "[data-test='add-on-row-0']")

    lv
    |> form("[data-test='rate-card-form']",
      rate_card: %{add_ons: %{"0" => %{name: "Inside fridge", dollars: "15.00"}}}
    )
    |> render_submit()

    rate_card = Quoting.get_or_create_rate_card(scope)
    assert rate_card.add_on_rates_cents == %{"Inside fridge" => 1500}
  end

  test "Remove control drops a persisted add-on on save", %{conn: conn} do
    scope = scope_fixture()

    {:ok, _rate_card} =
      Quoting.update_rate_card(scope, Quoting.get_or_create_rate_card(scope), %{
        add_on_rates_cents: %{"inside_fridge" => 1500}
      })

    {:ok, lv, _html} = live(log_in(conn, scope), ~p"/quotes/rate-card")
    assert has_element?(lv, "[data-test='add-on-row-0']")

    lv |> element("[data-test='remove-add-on-0']") |> render_click()
    refute has_element?(lv, "[data-test='add-on-row-0']")

    lv
    |> form("[data-test='rate-card-form']", rate_card: %{})
    |> render_submit()

    rate_card = Quoting.get_or_create_rate_card(scope)
    assert rate_card.add_on_rates_cents == %{}
  end

  test "rejects a named add-on left unpriced", %{conn: conn} do
    scope = scope_fixture()
    {:ok, lv, _html} = live(log_in(conn, scope), ~p"/quotes/rate-card")

    lv |> element("[data-test='add-add-on-button']") |> render_click()

    html =
      lv
      |> form("[data-test='rate-card-form']",
        rate_card: %{add_ons: %{"0" => %{name: "Inside fridge", dollars: ""}}}
      )
      |> render_submit()

    assert html =~ "must map add-on names to whole cent amounts"
    assert Quoting.get_or_create_rate_card(scope).add_on_rates_cents == %{}
  end
end

    assert Portal.get_cancellation_policy(scope.active_account_id).late_fee_cents == 1_200
  end

    {:ok, lv, _html} = live(log_in(conn, scope), ~p"/settings/booking")

    assert html =~ "must be greater than or equal to"
    assert Portal.get_cancellation_policy(scope.active_account_id).notice_window_hours == 24
  end

    scope = Scope.for_user(user)
    {:ok, account} = Accounts.create_account(scope, %{name: "Sparkle Co"})

    :ok
  rescue
    UndefinedFunctionError -> :ok
  end

content.text:
Reported to the team lead. Summary of the work:

**Issue 1 (past-date reschedule, high):** `Portal.reschedule_visit/3` is now `/4` with an injectable `now \\ DateTime.utc_now()`, refusing `{:error, :slot_in_past}` by mirroring `Booking.Lead.slot_in_future?/2`'s date/time comparison. `PortalLive.Visit` catches that error and re-renders the reschedule form with a field-level error ("must be today or later" or "must be later than the current time") instead of silently accepting the stale date.

**Issue 2 (blank cleaner name, medium):** `PortalLive.Visit.cleaner_name/1` now falls back to the cleaner's email when their name is nil or blank, and only shows "Not yet assigned" when no cleaner is actually associated.

**Issue 3 (no owner UI for cancellation policy, high):** Added `CleanerCrmWeb.SettingsLive.BookingPolicy` at `/settings/booking`, gated by `RequireOfficeRole`, editing notice-window hours, late fee, same-day fee (dollar inputs converted to cents like `QuoteLive.RateCard`), and the policy text. Backed by a new `Portal.change_cancellation_policy/3`; the portal still works off in-memory defaults when no row is saved. Linked from `QuoteLive.Index`.

Verification: `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` clean, spex 851 (7/7) and 849 (8/8) green, full `mix test` at 262 tests/0 failures, `mix format` applied. All three issues resolved via the QA MCP tool. This needs a release rebuild since the running instance is serving the pre-fix code.
